notes.title: Starship Troopers: Extermination Development Update (September 2025)
notes.content:
[h2][b]Hey Troopers,[/b][/h2][p][b]
[/b]Hopefully, everyone is enjoying update 1.6 and diving deep into the galactic front to fight back against the Bug. That one was a massive lift from the team, and we’re already hard at work behind the scenes on the next update. Our director has been testing new spawn combinations, and thanks to server-side adjustments, we’ve been able to squash issues faster than ever before.[/p][p][b]But enough about 1.6 - Let’s talk about what’s next.[/b][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Update 1.7 arrives at the end of October, and it’s a big one.[/b][/h3][p][b]
[/b]For the first time since launch, we’re adding a brand-new map that rivals Agni and Planet X-11 in scale. Only this time, it’s not a planet. Troopers, prepare yourselves for the fight of your life within the walls of the [b]Sparta[/b].[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43269229/406866af2d5b954097c8948ee5f545e44078569a.png"][/img][/p][p]The Sparta is a massive spaceship. Every deck, corridor, and compartment is crawling with Bugs. There’s nowhere to hide, and the mission is clear: take back the ship from the Arachnid menace. General Rico’s SOG teams are already aboard, fighting tooth and nail to secure a foothold, but they’re outnumbered and need the DSV’s support.[/p][p]On the Sparta, Troopers will be able to deploy into [b]AAS[/b], [b]Horde[/b], [b]Hive Hunt[/b], and [b]SOG[/b] [b]Missions[/b].[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43269229/86b305181fb34174b887379a323116985442afae.png"][/img][/p][p]One final thing, Troopers: For all the latest Sparta and Scorpion news, we strongly recommend you check that you are signed up for our [b][url="https://mailchi.mp/offworldindustries.com/ste_newsletter"]newsletter[/url][/b]! Info will be dropped soon for troopers to learn about the upcoming fight coming to the Federation.[/p][p]We can’t wait for you to get your hands on this update. Thanks again for all your support.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Troopers stay sharp out there. - \[O] PMO[/b][/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43269229/ab591b67422a73fdac971de845cef294ce195ca9.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Hotfix Update 1.6.1 - Patch Notes
notes.content: [p]Update 1.6.1 will be available for troopers to download at [b]10 AM PT (GMT-7) [/b]on [b]Monday, August 25th.[/b][/p][p]This patch is a collection of bug fixes. If you'd like to discuss Update 1.6.1 with your fellow troopers, please feel free to join the [url="https://discord.com/invite/starshiptroopersgame"][b]Starship Troopers: Extermination Community Discord![/b][/url][/p][p]If you enjoy this update, please leave us a review on Steam. We greatly appreciate all the feedback we have received as we have developed Starship Troopers: Extermination throughout the year and on all the Galactic Fronts![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43269229/bdce70c237e0e8a9ff494b1e373f027aeba8fc0d.jpg"][/img][/p][h2][b]Highlights [/b][/h2][list][*][p]Addressed the inconsistent Warrior Bug weak point behavior.[/p][/*][*][p]Bugs will no longer unburrow into a closed Bug Hole.[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected Royal Guard weak point behavior; they now register hits consistently, not only from the front.[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]Gameplay & General Fixes[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Implemented a second collision pass on Agni Critical Strike.[/p][/*][*][p]Addressed inconsistent invisible walls around the top edge of the Valaka Critical Strike Arena that allowed players to get trapped out of bounds and see backfaces.[/p][/*][*][p]Addressed multiple spawn location irregularities across all planets.[/p][/*][*][p]Dropship location in Valaka Critical Strike no longer intersects with the drilling platform.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Valaka Critical Strike, where dying in a lava pool prevented respawn.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed missing texture on bug hole body part explosions.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in Horde where the remaining VO plays even after the base has been destroyed.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where Bugs were not being counted in the Extermination side objectives.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where deaths caused by cave collapses during Critical Strike consumed team respawn tickets.[/p][/*][*][p]Holo Trajectory Mod indicator no longer appears at troopers’ feet on spawn.[/p][/*][*][p]Restored VO playback for objective completions in Critical Strikes.[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved issue where players who died and fell into the ship could not respawn.[/p][/*][/list]

tags.bug: Addressed the inconsistent Warrior Bug weak point behavior.
Bugs will no longer unburrow into a closed Bug Hole.
Corrected Royal Guard weak point behavior; they now register hits consistently, not only from the front.
Implemented a second collision pass on Agni Critical Strike.
Addressed inconsistent invisible walls around the top edge of the Valaka Critical Strike Arena that allowed players to get trapped out of bounds and see backfaces.
Addressed multiple spawn location irregularities across all planets.
Dropship location in Valaka Critical Strike no longer intersects with the drilling platform.
Fixed Valaka Critical Strike, where dying in a lava pool prevented respawn.
Fixed missing texture on bug hole body part explosions.
Fixed an issue in Horde where the remaining VO plays even after the base has been destroyed.

Resolved issue where players who died and fell into the ship could not respawn.

notes.title: Starship Troopers Extermination copies Left 4 Dead's neatest trick in new update
notes.content:
Back when Left 4 Dead came out in 2008, one of its most notable features was an AI game system referred to as the 'Director.' This Director worked to keep the co-op game fresh, no matter how many times players shot and slashed through its levels, by dynamically adjusting elements like item and enemy spawn points or music cues based on individual player skill and status. Now, in an effort to improve player experience in a similar way, the Helldivers 2-style co-op game Starship Troopers: Extermination has added in its own version of L4D's director through a new update.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Starship Troopers: Extermination Development Update (August 2025)
notes.content: [h2][b]Hey Troopers,[/b][/h2][p]We’ve got a lot of exciting things coming your way in the next few months, and we wanted to give you a glimpse into what’s in development across our upcoming updates. Whether you’re a veteran of the Arachnid wars or a fresh recruit just hitting the frontlines, there’s never been a better time to Do Your Part![/p][p][/p][h3][b]Looking Ahead – Update 1.7 Drops Late October[/b][/h3][p]October brings with it a beast of an update. [b]Update 1.7[/b] is shaping up to be a major milestone, and here's a sneak peek at what's inside:[/p][list][*][p][b]New Boss Bug: The Scorpion [/b][/p][p]Making its deadly debut in [i]Starship Troopers: Extermination[/i], the [b]Scorpion[/b] is our next epic boss bug. Inspired by its short—but unforgettable—appearance in [i]Starship Troopers 3: Marauder[/i], this massive Arachnid is built to challenge even the most coordinated squads.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Galactic Front[/b][/p][p]A new warzone joins the battle, complete with new Galactic Perks, Missions and Mutators to challenge every Trooper in the Deep Space Vanguard.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Major Map [/b][/p][p]Our most atmospheric battlefield yet. This map draws heavy inspiration from the [i]Starship Troopers: Invasion[/i] animated feature film. Expect close quarter combat and a whole lot of spine tingling encounters with the Bug.  Are you afraid of the dark?[/p][/*][*][p][b]QoL Improvements & Bug Fixes [/b][/p][p]We’re continuing our mission to make the game smoother, more stable, and more fun to play. Expect dozens of community-requested improvements and fixes across the board.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3][b]Stay Frosty – More to Come[/b][/h3][p]We’ll be revealing more details about Update 1.7 and beyond this September. Until then, gear up, stay alert, and as always…[b]Kill every last one of them dirty Bugs![/b][/p][p][/p][h3][b]\[O] PMO - Project Lead[/b][/h3][p][i]Developer Updates are subject to change based on player feedback and development shifts.[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43269229/03bdc1c00c02f5c7384dddcaa9d806d818eeea46.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Update 1.6 Patch Notes
notes.content: [p]Update 1.6 will be available for troopers to download around [b]10 AM PT (GMT-7) [/b]on [b]Thursday, August 14th.[/b][/p][p]This patch is a collection of content, performance, and optimization improvements and bug fixes. If you'd like to discuss Update 1.6 with your fellow troopers, please feel free to join the [b][url="https://discord.com/invite/starshiptroopersgame"]Starship Troopers: Extermination Community Discord![/url][/b][/p][p]If you enjoy this update, please leave us a review on Steam. We greatly appreciate all the feedback that has been provided as we have developed Starship Troopers: Extermination throughout the year and all the Galactic Fronts![/p][p] [/p][h1][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcFEsKckj_AP7ddwt6FUAEC3pcXV_mMJSJ5Rf2t45yDlnIDtUsLG7MCCsfejVx-bkZkO2-QI1Z275M6s3QJuWanui957jh-z-p7qfV21kcPcC2divP7XtqdUP2_M8uOXkwsh64?key=OU_pvdIa5V7xE-BbjTC5vA"][/img][/h1][p][/p][h1][b]Server Performance Improvements[/b][/h1][list][*][p][b]Projectile Optimizations[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][i]Projectiles for most weapons (Explosive projectiles, such as rockets and grenades, are not affected) have received a performance and fidelity improvement. All Troopers should enjoy a smoother and more performant experience and enjoy more reliable weapon performance with additional features.[/i][/p][list][*][p]All projectiles are more performant.[/p][/*][*][p]Tracers are more visible and remain visible for longer[/p][/*][*][p]Some projectiles [b]can now ricochet[/b] off surfaces or armored bugs[/p][/*][*][p][b]Cosmetic System Replication Optimization[/b][/p][/*][/list][h1][b]Other Improvements[/b][/h1][p][/p][h2][i][b]The Director[/b][/i][b] — Our New Spawning System[/b][/h2][p]We’re excited to roll out a major upgrade to one of the game’s most important behind-the-scenes systems: [b]spawning[/b]. Internally, we’ve been calling this system [b]“The Director.”[/b] It’s a total overhaul of how we handle enemy spawns in [i]Starship Troopers: Extermination[/i], and it’s been in development for quite some time.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Why We Built The Director[/b][/h3][p]As the game has grown with new modes, difficulty settings, and more enemy types, we realized that our original spawning system, while functional, was starting to show its limits regarding maintenance and future improvements. We needed something that could scale with the game, improve performance, and, most importantly, create [b]more engaging and consistent gameplay[/b].[/p][p]So we set out to create a new system from the ground up that would give us:[/p][list][*][p][b]More control[/b] over when, where, and how bugs spawn[/p][/*][*][p][b]Scalability[/b] for different modes and future content[/p][/*][*][p][b]Better performance[/b] on both server and client[/p][/*][*][p]The ability to craft [b]intense, memorable combat pacing[/b] across all types of missions[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]What The Director Does[/b][/h3][p]At its core, The Director is a system that constantly evaluates the battlefield's state and decides when and where enemies should spawn. It takes into account things like player positioning, mission objectives, pacing intensity, and spawn zone availability.[/p][p]It’s not just about sending waves of bugs it’s about sending the [i]right[/i] kind of pressure at the right time. Whether you’re holding a point or racing to extract, The Director can adjust the tempo to make combat feel more dynamic and deliberate.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Key Improvements You’ll Notice:[/b][/h3][p][b]More Consistent Spawns[/b][/p][p]Spawns are now much more reliable and controllable. This helps reduce unfair or unpredictable moments and gives us tools to tune encounters with greater precision.[/p][p][b]Scalable Across Modes and Difficulties[/b][/p][p]We’ve built The Director to work not just in existing game modes, but in [b]future scenarios[/b] as well. This system will help us expand gameplay in meaningful ways, whether that’s horde-style modes, ARC missions, or new event challenges.[/p][p][b]Improved Performance[/b][/p][p]By optimizing how and when spawn decisions are made, we’ve reduced CPU load on both the server and client. This is especially noticeable in high-intensity moments with many Bugs on screen.[/p][p][b]Better Gameplay Moments[/b][/p][p]One of our goals was to give designers more control to create [b]crafted gameplay beats[/b] moments of tension, relief, and chaos that feel cinematic and satisfying. The Director allows us to build those experiences more reliably.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]What’s Next?[/b][/h3][p]This system is just the beginning, a foundation for the future. With the Director in place, we now have the tools to push combat encounters even further, with more variety, smarter pacing, and more ways to surprise and challenge you.[/p][p]As always, we’ll be listening to your feedback on how it feels in the wild. This is a big change, and we’ll be keeping a close eye on how it impacts different playstyles and missions.[/p][p]Thanks for being on this ride with us. We can’t wait to see how you handle what the Director throws your way.[/p][p][/p][h1][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdmF8wBXhl2M1Zj_mk5b3o5Du6n4mGY6NsO8gflIadh61uzBUl2jW4Ja2TYACGJtN3Fp1rGb9vgg7iSsSTD_50zsbtaAI8miEJsW2w1Fq24u7F2vIqEEFqTt9GmRTo81C0_nMeS?key=OU_pvdIa5V7xE-BbjTC5vA"][/img][/h1][p][/p][h2][b]Critical Strike[/b][/h2][p][i]Federation scans have picked up large reserves of Archigeon deep underground after meteor strikes have hit remote areas on both Valaka and Agni Prime. Only the best of the best will be tasked with marching headfirst into bug territory to retrieve it. [/i][/p][p][i]In this Critical Strike, although you can choose where you redeploy, troopers will fight separated from their other squads and pave a path through these undocumented areas, pushing through swarms of bugs to claim the Archnigeon for the Federation![/i][/p][p][i]Previous squads have failed this challenge. Troopers are [b]heavily encouraged[/b] to finish their work along the way, completing side objectives to earn themselves more XP, more valor in the eyes of the Federation, and more rewards to help them down the line. There have been rumors of an even larger bug presence protecting the Archingeon, and the Federation encourages you to be prepared for whatever you might run into out there.[/i][/p][p][i]Get out there and take down those bugs, Troopers![/i][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Bug Holes[/b][/h2][p][i]The Arachnids have developed a new method to connect their bug-filled Hives directly to our at-risk Federation assets. These ‘Bug Hole’ access points create openings in the ground that bugs will pour through. This cowardly strategy can cause significant logistical strain as the flow of bugs will only be stopped by collapsing their tunnel entrances.[/i][/p][p][i]Troopers [b]will need to[/b] use explosives to close Bug Holes; Nuke Detpacks or other tactical nuclear devices will be the most effective utilities for dealing with these new threats.[/i][/p][p][i]This has been deemed a top priority, and all available Vanguards Troopers are expected to locate and destroy any Bug Holes they encounter.[/i][/p][p][/p][h2][b]M-55 Rocket Launcher[/b][/h2][p][i]A portable launcher capable of firing powerful tactical nuclear warheads. The M55 is the Federation's best answer to the Arachnid menace.[/i][/p][p][i]Thanks to the efforts of our friends in Federation R&D, these launchers now fire guided rockets. This allows Troopers to steer their deadly payloads mid-flight to improve the chance of a direct hit! Early field testing has already proven a statistically significant improvement to weapon lethality and a likewise reduction in friendly fire incidents.[/i] [/p][p][i]MI Command reminds Troopers to stay close and protect their teammates as the limited ammunition and arduous reloading process leave rocket teams vulnerable to bug counterattacks.[/i][/p][p][i]Look for special M-55 Caches during the next Galactic Front. [b]This weapon must be earned through completing the first few phases of the front.[/b] After the Galactic Front’s conclusion, additional M-55 Caches will only be committed if enough Galactic Front strategic targets have been secured. Only Total Victory in the Galactic Front will ensure these tactical assets are allocated to the most deserving Troopers.[/i][/p][p] [/p][h2][b]Galactic Front Leaderboard[/b][/h2][p][i]Federation Leadership has discovered that pitting our heroes against each other is the most effective way to improve combat effectiveness.[/i][/p][p][i]To support these efforts, Company performance will now be publicly displayed. All participating Trooper Companies will now be able to see their standing during a Galactic Front. Company members will be able to see how their Company stacks up against the competition. Company officers will be able to decide how to handle the new leaderboards – whether they rise to meet the challenge or take a trip down washout lane.[/i][/p][p] [/p][h1][b]Quality-of-Life[/b][/h1][p][/p][h3][b]FedNet Approval Feed[/b][/h3][p][i]The Approval feed presents FedCam Approval information in nearly the same way as the XP feed, which often causes confusion. Camera operators often conflate earning Approval with earning XP. The new Approval feed has been made more visually distinct to help reduce confusion.[/i][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Hive Hunt[/b][/h3][p][i]When completing a phase of Hive Hunt a Forward Spawn point will be automatically created and additional T.O.A.D canisters will be spawned ahead instead of behind. This will help to reduce backtracking and keep the mission moving forward.[/i][/p][list][*][p]The next Forward Spawn point will be automatically built upon completion of a Hive Hunt phase.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Royal Guard Elite[/b][/h3][p]The Deep Space Vanguard continues to crush Bug forces, reducing Hive activity to a mere trickle. However, intelligence reports a new threat: an evolved mutation of the Royal Guard, now designated the "Elite."  Federation scientists confirm the Elite is significantly stronger and deadlier than its predecessor—though visually indistinguishable.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]The Federation Stands Strong in Boreas[/b][/h3][p]The Federation is strengthening its foothold on Boreas. Federation engineers are hard at work building new outposts and other structures.[/p][p] [/p][h1][b]Tuning[/b][/h1][p][/p][h2][b]Arachnid Tuning[/b][/h2][h3][b]Royal Guard[/b][/h3][p][i]It was observed that Royal Guards did not have the expected resistance to explosives. It now appears that new mutations have rectified this weakness. Troopers are expected to handle these threats with increased caution as Royal Guards show traits seen in their closely related Tiger Elite phenotypes.[/i][/p][list][*][p]Improved Explosive Damage Resistance to [b]50% [/b](Grenades, Chi-Hong)[/p][/*][*][p]Improved Demolition Damage Resistance to [b]50% [/b](Thermo Charges, Hi-Ex, Nukes)[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h2][b]Armory Tuning[/b][/h2][h3][b]TW-205-E Morita II[/b][/h3][p][i]The Federation has addressed usability concerns with the XW-900 Underbarrel Plasma Launcher encountered by frontline Vanguard units. Troopers should notice an overall handling improvement while on the move.[/i][/p][list][*][p]Renamed [b]Morita II → TW-205-E Morita II[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Improved [b]Underbarrel Experimental Plasma Launcher[/b] handling and accuracy[/p][list][*][p]Move Deviation recovery improved from [b]1.5 → 30.0[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Max Move Deviation improved from[b] 6.0 → 4.0[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Move Sway recovery improved from [b]1.5 → 6.0[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Max Move Sway improved from [b]25.0 → 5.0[/b][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][i]Move Deviation affects how much the accuracy blooms while on the move, and Sway affects how much the aim bounces while on the move.[/i][/p][p] [/p][h3][b]C-32 Chi-Hong MGL[/b][/h3][p][i]The Chi-Hong gets the new [b]Holo Trajectory[/b] modification allowing the Trooper to preview the estimated impact location of their grenades.[/i][/p][list][*][p]Added [b]Holo Trajectory[/b] sight mod at level [b]4[/b][/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Nuke Detpack[/b][/h3][p][i]Deployed explosives are getting improved hit registration. Helping to ensure that all Bugs in the area of effect are equally affected by the explosions and can no longer be protected by hiding behind or inside the piles of their fallen companions.[/i][/p][list][*][p]Improving the hit consistency of large explosives[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Proximity Mines[/b][/h3][p][i]Proximity Mines are getting a significant improvement to compensate for their lack of utility. They are now packed full of even more explosives to better deal with the larger Arachnid types. In addition, the Proximity Mines will be getting the same improvements to area of effect hit registration.[/i][/p][list][*][p]Explosive Damage increased from [b]1000 → 6000[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Improving the hit consistency of large explosives[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h2][b]Mission Tuning[/b][/h2][h3][b]AAS Exterminations[/b][/h3][p][i]We have reintroduced Arachnid Exterminations into the Advance and Secure missions. Troopers can now be tasked with exterminating a target number of bugs to complete the objective.[/i][/p][p][/p][h3][b]New Mutators[/b][/h3][p][i]Keep an eye out for new scenario modifiers! These Mutators will begin appearing with the launch of the next Galactic Front. [/i][/p][list][*][p]Added [b]Bug Batteries[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]Rescue Mission[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]M-55 Cache[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]PLEASE NOTE: The M-55 cache will not be active until a certain phase of the Galactic Front is reached![/b][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Mutator Weapon/Utility Crates[/b][/h3][p][i]Troopers will have an easier time locating these supplies. Crates will now be found in clusters and placed in more visible locations.[/i][/p][list][*][p]All existing Mutators that spawned Weapon Crates randomly in a mission have been adjusted (Blizzard, Pitch Black, Sandstorm, Pilum Surplus)[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p align="center"][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdKM9xYvj_wXFM9QWsUHvjGnpn0iiNEbNtXEzkiu6i6S5vaAK4PRz22idDgnDAUFB01rYlEL8lQqQCiBEB5lWwozjIO9z1JsY80WmTGVrU1q4O2P2HPj088NkJ97mCCa7whsw4C?key=OU_pvdIa5V7xE-BbjTC5vA"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Known Issues[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Certain AAS missions may be blocked. We're investigating to fix this. Destroying bug holes may remedy the issue.[/p][/*][*][p]Friendly Fire may be more sensitive than normal. Please be wary of hurting your fellow troopers.[/p][/*][*][p]Users may need to reapply their cosmetics.[/p][/*][*][p]Players might ragdoll into the ship and will not be able to respawn until revived by another player[/p][/*][*][p]Some weapons may not track XP properly; this is very inconsistent and rare, and we are working on a fix for a future patch as we are deep into optimizing the logic for the weapon XP system.[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]Highlights [/b][/h2][list][*][p]Addressed an issue that stopped explosive rounds from the Morita XXX from being applied and working correctly in missions.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved Tanker Bug pathfinding when navigating complex terrain.[/p][/*][*][p]Re-added Extermination side objectives to AAS missions[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that caused T.O.A.D Canisters to get lost in the dropship if they were never recovered, or were respawned there when the dropship was leaving.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where spectating could find the player cycling through the same camera view.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Thermo Charge Detonator sometimes failed to trigger an explosion.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an interaction where the FedNet Camera could push player ragdolls through the ground and out of bounds.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where players could become trapped inside the MBU and Bunkers. [/p][/*][/list][h2][b]Console Fixes[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where on console, the Left Face buttons would not open the Virtual Keyboard on the Company screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Top Companies tab could not be scrolled on consoles.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that made the Members tab unscrollable on consoles.[/p][/*][*][p]\[PS5] Fixed an issue where platform invite/join features stopped working after a crash.[/p][/*][*][p]\[PS5] Fixed an issue where no buttons could be pressed after entering the Company tab.[/p][/*][*][p]\[XBox] Resolved a server disconnection caused by a gameplay freeze on a Horde map.[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]UI[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Engineers who died with a canister on their back should no longer have a permanent icon of the canister in the sixth tags.feature: Some projectiles can now ricochet off surfaces or armored bugs
We’re excited to roll out a major upgrade to one of the game’s most important behind-the-scenes systems: spawning. Internally, we’ve been calling this system “The Director.”

In this Critical Strike, although you can choose where you redeploy, troopers will fight separated from their other squads and pave a path through these undocumented areas, pushing through swarms of bugs to claim the Archnigeon for the Federation!

The Arachnids have developed a new method to connect their bug-filled Hives directly to our at-risk Federation assets. These ‘Bug Hole’ access points create openings in the ground that bugs will pour through.
Thanks to the efforts of our friends in Federation R&D, these launchers now fire guided rockets. This allows Troopers to steer their deadly payloads mid-flight to improve the chance of a direct hit!
Company performance will now be publicly displayed.
The Chi-Hong gets the new Holo Trajectory modification allowing the Trooper to preview the estimated impact location of their grenades.
Added Holo Trajectory sight mod at level 4
We have reintroduced Arachnid Exterminations into the Advance and Secure missions.
Keep an eye out for new scenario modifiers! These Mutators will begin appearing with the launch of the next Galactic Front.
Added Bug Batteries
Added Rescue Mission
Added M-55 Cache
New mission map has been added for Critical Strike on Agni Prime
New mission map has been added for Critical Strike on Valaka

notes.title: Starship Troopers: Extermination Development Update (July 2025)
notes.content: [h2][b]To Our Brave Troopers,[/b][/h2][p]Summer has kicked off in full force, and here at the Federation, we’re only just getting started. The road ahead is packed with new content, surprises, and full-scale battles that will shape the future of Starship Troopers: Extermination. But before we charge forward into the next phase of the Galactic War, let’s take a moment to reflect on what we’ve accomplished together over the past six months.[/p][p]It’s been an incredibly busy and rewarding time for our team, and we couldn’t have done it without your continued support, feedback, and bug-stomping commitment. Together, we’ve deployed four major game updates, each packed with performance optimizations, bug fixes, and content designed to enhance the experience on the frontlines.[/p][p]Here are just a few of the highlights we’ve introduced:[/p][list][*][p][b]Company Invites and Chat[/b] – Making it easier than ever to squad up and stay connected with your fellow Troopers.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Galactic War Perks[/b] – With each war fought, fresh perks have arrived to help shape your strategy and squad loadout.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Staged Reload Mechanics[/b] – Adding more tactical depth to combat engagements.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Dynamic Sky and Weather Systems[/b] – Immersive environmental changes that bring the battlefield to life.[/p][/*][*][p][b]FedNet Camera[/b] – Letting you relive your greatest victories (and most heroic last stands).[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Weapons, Weapon Mods, and Quality of Life Improvement[/b]s – Giving you more tools to fight smarter and harder.[/p][/*][*][p][b]16 Player Hive Hunt missions[/b] – This is Phase 1, with more to come in future updates.[/p][/*][/list][p]And that’s just scratching the surface. It’s safe to say these past six months have been among the most productive in our game's development history, and believe us when we say: There's a lot more on the way!.[/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]Looking Ahead: Update 1.6[/b][/h3][p]Now let’s talk about what’s coming next.[/p][p]Update 1.6 marks a major milestone in our ongoing fight against the Arachnid menace. One of the most significant changes is the full rollout of our brand-new Bug Spawning System. A feature our team has been working on for many months. This system completely replaces our previous spawning setup and offers improved scalability, predictability, and creative flexibility moving forward.[/p][p]The Federation has kindly provided this small sneak peek behind the scenes of the Bug Spawning technology. Although there isn't much we can share to ensure Federation Intelligence remains uncompromised, we hope troopers are ready for what is coming.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43269229/7b1822bbca3c28e4711e94a1d3392d088d7c5cf3.jpg"][/img][/p][p]We want to be upfront: while this new system won’t be perfect at launch, it will be a powerful step forward in allowing our live operations team, including the ever-watchful Game Master, to dynamically influence the battlefield without requiring full client updates. Expect more reactive, varied, and intense battles as we put this new toolset through its paces.[/p][p]To showcase the power of this tech, we’re also introducing Bug Holes, volatile hotspots emerging across contested planets in the galaxy. These active nests are a growing threat, and it’ll be up to you and your squad to locate and neutralize them. Whether you go in guns blazing or drop an M-55 Nuke to erase them from existence, one thing’s for sure: the Bugs are evolving, and so must we.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43269229/b7eb3a11f2d97dbaf9290d729f633d840879991f.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]A Brand-New Game Mode: Critical Strike[/b][/h3][p]Update 1.6 also marks the launch of our first new game mode since release: Critical Strike. This mode centers around the discovery and extraction of a powerful new resource, Archnigeon, first encountered on Boreas. Recent scans have detected Bug meteorites containing traces of Achnigeon on previously unexplored sectors of Agni Prime and Valaka.[/p][p]Your mission is simple: secure the resource, destroy the Bug threat, and ensure the Federation secures ample supplies of this vital material.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p]As always, thank you for fighting the good fight. Your passion, feedback, and bug-slaying dedication continue to shape the future of this game. Stay alert, stay armed, and stay connected. The next phase of the war is nearly upon us.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]For the Federation! - Project Lead PMO[/b][/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43269229/bc2b5d11379417e530d0a7e06b0ed6a24a53bcef.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Update 1.5 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[p]Update 1.5 will be available for troopers to download at [b]10 AM PT (GMT-7) [/b]on [b]June 23rd, 2025.[/b][/p][p]This patch is a collection of content, performance, optimization improvements, and bug fixes. If you'd like to discuss Update 1.5 with your fellow troopers, please feel free to join the [b][url="https://discord.com/invite/starshiptroopersgame"]Starship Troopers: Extermination Community Discord![/url][/b] [/p][p]The Federation thanks every trooper who's already delivered valuable feedback from the front lines. Your input strengthens our campaign and helps us build the updates you deserve![/p][p][b]Haven’t reported in yet?[/b] We need every voice in this war effort drop us a Steam review and let Command know what you think. Every opinion helps the cause.[/p][h1][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXe9Zx3KUKQ1WDVzWhPr25tp96v3zv03hRMweAbrwwENTw_ZRDpUb_wEhU-UuiWxp5_38uBfC2xWJan-aIg-J-mcEkV0XE0V-Q0wIUP_cYgywZZ8Zlw2J_CaL5b-p7HFIMWm1NY?key=o3ZGNuonttBWONSGzWbRvg"][/img][/h1][p][/p][h2][b]16 Player Hive Hunt[/b][/h2][p][i]The Arachnid menace and their escalating ferocity in defending their nurseries has forced the Federation to escalate our own response. To meet this new threat head-on, the Deepspace Vanguard has approved the immediate deployment of [b]16 troopers [/b]for all Hive Hunt missions![/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43269229/ccc58877e9a89f6ea5bca55c6fe21c83ff324734.jpg"][/img][/p][p][i]And to support this new aggressive deployment strategy, the Federation has simultaneously rolled out the brand-new [b]Timer Operated Atomic Device Canisters[/b], or T.O.A.D Canisters. The personal Det Packs have been replaced with the nearly-as-portable T.O.A.D Canisters. [/i][/p][p][i]These Nuclear payloads now require a heroic trooper to carry and manually place them on an Arachnid Hive Cores to permanently destroy the hive structure. Additional troopers will be required to escort the dedicated Nuke carriers into the hive.[/i][/p][list][*][p]Hive Hunt has been converted from [b]4 Players → 16 Players.[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Hive destruction requires the [b]escorting of T.O.A.D Canisters into the Hives.[/b][/p][/*][/list][h2][b]Morita II[/b][/h2][p][i]Federation scientists are happy to report the arrival of the much-anticipated successor to the Morita rifle, the Morita II! With its many quirks and futuristic aesthetics, the Deepspace Vanguard is happy to begin field testing of this brand-new prototype weapon.[/i][/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43269229/ed660a555d976cf764db07e1f39e5d81e7477060.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][i]In its standard configuration, the Morita II is a powerful burst-fire rifle with an explosive underbarrel grenade launcher. With its extended range of Weapon Modifications, the Morita II can be customized for any combat situation, allowing each class to customize their weapon to their liking. [/i][/p][p][i]Use the [b]Fully Automatic[/b] modification to change the controlled burst-fire into a flurry of caseless bullet fire. Or equip the [b]Experimental Plasma Launcher [/b]to vaporize Tigers into mist.[/i]
[/p][p][i]This new weapon will be available to all classes upon reaching level [b]16[/b].[/i]
[/p][p][i]Happy hunting, troopers![/i][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Stinging Fury[/b][/h2][p][i]Unleash a bold new look with the new [b]Stinging Fury Supporter Pack[/b]. A new addition to the Federation cosmetic lineup. Available to purchase with Update 1.5, this pack lets troopers customize their gear with a striking new palette for their weapons, armor, and visors. It also includes a unique profile banner and icon to complete your battlefield presence.[/i] [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43269229/97594620dc61774925f9461df207b867df629f60.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]Horde Mode[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Rounds are now timer-based and not dependent on # of Bugs killed.[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]Quick Player Filtering[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Matches can now be filtered via Mission Type and Difficulty.[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]Galactic Front Updates[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Intel has been removed as a Company Ops purchase currency.[/p][/*][*][p]A selection of Company Ops will always be available whenever a Galactic Front is active.[/p][list][*][p]The selection will change on a 6-hour rotation.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h2][b]PC[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Steam Deck[/p][list][*][p]Virtual Keyboard input fixes.[/p][/*][*][p]Steam Deck increased font sizing. [/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Upscaler Upgrades:[/p][list][*][p]DLSS 4[/p][/*][*][p]FSR v3.1.3a (FSR 4 on supported cards)[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h2][b]Ultra Dynamic Sky[/b][/h2][list][*][p]X-11 Dynamic Sky added. [/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h1][b]Quality-of-Life[/b][/h1][h3][b]Spotlights[/b][/h3][p][i]Spotlights have been adjusted to support interactions with more Engineer perks and utilities. The Overcharge module is now able to over-repair and overcharge Spotlights. [/i][/p][p][i]The [b]Reinforced Repairs perk now provides additional blue Health [/b]to the Spotlights. The [b]Overcharge Module can now Overcharge[/b] the Spotlights; this will temporarily boost the light intensity as well as allow the light to continue operating even when damaged.[/i][/p][list][*][p]Spotlights can now be reinforced.[/p][/*][*][p]Spotlights can now be overcharged.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Resource Canisters[/b][/h3][p][i]Troopers carrying a resource canister will now have an icon displayed on the Tac Map and on the HUD.[/i][/p][h3][b]Sky Marshall and Rico Visual Update[/b][/h3][p][i]We've changed the static images of Sky Marshall and Rico to animated video sequences. Using our original character images and  voiceover files, we leveraged AI-powered facial animation and lip-sync technology to closely match their spoken performances.[/i][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Armory Tuning[/b][/h2][h3][b]Morita XXX[/b][/h3][p][i]The premier anti-tiger sniper rifle is receiving a few new Weapon Modifications to assist troopers in their fight against the bugs. The [b]Explosive Rounds[/b] modification replaces the standard Anti-materiel ammo with a High Explosive charge, more effective against unarmored bugs in tight groups with a devastating impact against weak points, and the [b]Short Scope[/b] modification provides the more CQC-focused snipers with a short ranged sight that provides modestly improved handling and reduced sway.[/i][/p][list][*][p]Added [b]Short Scope (2x)[/b] sight mod at level [b]6.[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]Explosive Rounds[/b] ammo mod at level [b]8.[/b][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]TW-2-R Sp.L.I.T Shotgun (Slug)[/b][/h3][p][i]The slug-variant of the Sp.L.I.T was less flexible than other shotguns, new Weapon Modifications are being issued to provide new opportunities for Rangers to customize their slug-slinging antics. The [b]Heavy Slugs [/b]modification uses heavier ammunition for increased damage at the expense of accuracy and armor penetration, and the [b]Short Scope[/b] provides an improved sight for mid range psuedo-sniping (if that opportunity presents itself.)[/i][/p][list][*][p]Added [b]Heavy Slugs[/b] ammo mod at level [b]7.[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]Short Scope (2.5x)[/b] sight mod at level [b]8.[/b][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]FU-17 Flamethrower[/b][/h3][p][i]The trusty Flamethrower can be a situational weapon depending on the types of targets encountered. To better highlight these strengths and weaknesses, we’ve improved the weapon’s hit marker feedback. In addition, we’ve provided a few improvements to the FU-17’s overall usability with improved consistency and increased reserve ammo. [/i][/p][list][*][p][b]Added hit markers[/b]: Critical hit markers will display when dealing additional damage, and Resist hit markers will display when dealing less damage or no damage.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Flames now pierce through bugs[/b] in the area of effect.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Slowing effect now applies to Fire Warriors and Inferno bugs.[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Ammo increased from [b]300 → 400.[/b][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Speed Stim Fabricator[/b][/h3][p][i]The Federation has replaced the current Speed Stims with a more potent cocktail. Each individual stim will now provide a larger movement speed boost that lasts longer. However, the effect can no longer be stacked multiple times to increase the effectiveness.[/i][/p][list][*][p]Movement speed boost increased from [b]15% → 30%.[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Duration increased from [b]10 seconds → 15 seconds.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Effect no longer stacks.[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Has a new visual effect while speed boosted.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Lure Grenades[/b][/h3][p][i]Bugs will now have reduced targeting against Lure Grenades. While some scientists suggest this could be an example of bugs adapting to our tactics, other scientists suggest the suggestion that a bug can learn is offensive. We are making a minor adjustment to Lure Grenades, because they were already individually effective but when combined with the Demolisher’s Barrage they could be used to easily control entire hordes of bugs.[/i][/p][list][*][p][b]Targeting priority reduced.[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Max number of attracted bugs reduced from [b]10 → 4.[/b][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Nuke Detpack[/b][/h3][p][i]With the reduction in Lure Grenades effectiveness, we wanted to provide Demolishers with new methods for defensive crowd control, and allow the Nukes to be used in situational offensive actions.[/i][/p][list][*][p][b]Deployed Nuke Detpacks will now attract nearby bugs.[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Minimum Damage increased from [b]750 → 1100.[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcrs_WId4wrYb9eDNqzY5HB3pt_F6Mp63KPwR-y9aup8yCCApRgS8AEH8yWUiKSJuCzuBNG6l1tb-iqcStO_3bRDFe-ot9zt6o7WIh7UNCfHW5F_5qOQ16uLXJC2i0YMr6F1aZ_?key=o3ZGNuonttBWONSGzWbRvg"][/img][/p][h2][b]Known Issues[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Underbarrel reloads have missing visuals due to LOD issue when using Low settings on PC.[/p][/*][*][p]UI issue when switching weapons. tags.feature:
Hive Hunt has been converted from 4 Players 
 16 Players.
Hive destruction requires the escorting of T.O.A.D Canisters into the Hives.
Federation scientists are happy to report the arrival of the much-anticipated successor to the Morita rifle, the Morita II!
This new weapon will be available to all classes upon reaching level 16.
Unleash a bold new look with the new Stinging Fury Supporter Pack.

tags.balance_change: Rounds are now timer-based and not dependent on # of Bugs killed.

tags.feature: Matches can now be filtered via Mission Type and Difficulty.

tags.balance_change: Intel has been removed as a Company Ops purchase currency.

tags.feature: A selection of Company Ops will always be available whenever a Galactic Front is active.
The selection will change on a 6-hour rotation.

tags.bug: Virtual Keyboard input fixes.

tags.feature: Steam Deck increased font sizing.
DLSS 4
FSR v3.1.3a (FSR 4 on supported cards)
X-11 Dynamic Sky added.
Spotlights can now be reinforced.
Spotlights can now be overcharged.
Troopers carrying a resource canister will now have an icon displayed on the Tac Map and on the HUD.
We've changed the static images of Sky Marshall and Rico to animated video sequences.
Added Short Scope (2x) sight mod at level 6.
Added Explosive Rounds ammo mod at level 8.
Added Heavy Slugs ammo mod at level 7.
Added Short Scope (2.5x) sight mod at level 8.
Added hit markers: Critical hit markers will display when dealing additional damage, and Resist hit markers will display when dealing less damage or no damage.
Flames now pierce through bugs in the area of effect.
Slowing effect now applies to Fire Warriors and Inferno bugs.

notes.title: Starship Troopers: Extermination Development Update (June 9th, 2025)
notes.content:
[h2][b]Hello, Brave Troopers,[/b][/h2][p]Summer is just around the corner and so is [b]Update 1.5: Phantoms Nest[/b], and with it comes a wave of exciting updates for [i]Starship Troopers: Extermination[/i].[/p][p]First up, [b]Update 1.5[/b] is almost ready to drop, and here’s a quick refresher on what’s coming your way:[/p][list][*][p][b]Hive Hunt expands to 16 players[/b], introducing a brand-new [b]“Escort the Nuke”[/b] mechanic.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Horde mode[/b] has been rebalanced, and [b]wave progression is time-based[/b], not tied to the number of Bugs you kill.[/p][/*][*][p]The [b]Morita MK2[/b] joins the Vanguard arsenal, equipped with a powerful [b]experimental plasma attachment[/b] to unleash chaos on the Bug menace.[/p][/*][*][p]New weapon Mods added for the [b]Morita XXX[/b] and [b]TW-2-R Sp.L.I.T Shotgun (Slug) [/b][/p][/*][*][p]And of course, we’ve implemented a significant [b]revamp to Galactic War[/b] alongside a suite of [b]quality-of-life improvements[/b] and [b]bug fixes[/b].
[/p][/*][/list][p]But that’s not all. Later this summer, we’re preparing to launch one of our biggest updates yet, featuring the long-awaited [b]New Bug Spawning System[/b]. This new tech completely overhauls how enemy encounters unfold, giving us new tools to ensure intense, immersive action across every match.[/p][p]This major update also introduces our [b]first new game mode since Hive Hunt[/b]. Designed to complement our existing modes, this new experience brings a big challenge for you all. You’ll deploy to [b]Valaka[/b] and [b]Agni Prime[/b] in pursuit of [b]Archnigeon[/b], a mysterious resource first discovered on Boreas. With the potential to shift the tides of war in the Federation’s favor, Archnigeon is now being found in other systems and the race is on to secure it.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43269229/e20cdc69e6a4044677bf58295766c39f21233da8.jpg"][/img][/p][p]This is only the beginning of [b]Operation: Critical Strike[/b]. We plan to expand this mode with new mechanics and levels in the future.[/p][p]We’ll be sharing full details on [b]Update 1.6[/b] in our [b]July Transmission[/b], but our current mission objective is to deploy 1.6 in [b]August[/b].[/p][p]Until then, stay sharp, Troopers!  The future of the Federation depends on you![/p][p][/p][h3][b]FOR THE FEDERATION! - Project Lead PMO[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][b]Please be mindful that everything below is subject to change based on the development progress and testing outcomes.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43269229/6fbfc939c4807f44a866195106032cc2ec923a58.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Starship Troopers: Extermination Development Update (May 9th, 2025)
notes.content:
[h2][b]Hello, fellow Troopers,[/b][/h2]

[b]First off, CONGRATULATIONS on the glorious victory on Valaka during Operation: Disputed Sands![/b] Your bravery and determination are helping turn the tide in our war against the Bug. The entire Federation salutes your efforts. You’ve made us proud!

Now, it’s May, and we’ve got a lot to cover. So let’s dive in!

[h2][b]Update 1.4: Federation Heroism & More[/b][/h2]

Update 1.4 marked another exciting milestone for the game! We introduced Federation Heroism, a brand-new feature that lets players live out the fantasy of being embedded combat camera crews capturing the action, the glory, and the chaos of battle. [b]Lights, camera, BUG SPLAT![/b]

We also added the underbarrel attachment for the standard-issue TW-201-S Morita I. This gives our Troopers even more flexibility and firepower in the field. More tools, more ways to crush the enemy!

[h2][b]Looking Ahead to Update 1.5[/b][/h2]

Coming in late June, Update 1.5 is shaping up to be another big one. Here’s what you can expect:

[h3][b]A New Galactic Front[/b][/h3]
As mentioned in our April Development Update, 1.5 will introduce a brand-new Galactic Front, bringing with it some changes to how players access Company Operations. Expect fresh mission flow, new challenges, and more dynamic ways to serve the Federation.

[h3][b]Introducing the Morita II[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43269229/5559e03c847c8d43c991de59aeb67dc6fee6cec2.jpg[/img]
That’s right! A new addition to your arsenal! The Morita II will offer players another dual-firing weapon, perfect for adapting to different battlefield scenarios. More boom, more bug-busting fun.

[h3][b]Quickplay Filtering[/b][/h3]
We’re giving players more control over how they jump into matches. With 1.5, Quickplay filters will let you choose:[list][*] Company Ops (when active) or General Missions
[*] Difficulty Level
[*] Game Mode[/list]Keep in mind: the more filters you apply, the more it might affect your specific queue times. But you’ll be lining up for exactly the type of mission you want.

[h3][b]A little surprise for 1.5[/b][/h3]

[h3][b]Hive Hunt: Major Overhaul Incoming[/b][/h3]

Based on your feedback and our analytics it’s clear: players want Hive Hunt to support 16-player matchmaking. So, starting in 1.5, Hive Hunt will become a [b]16-player-only mode[/b]!

This is Part 1 of an even larger revamp aimed at making Hive Hunt a core part of the 16-player experience. We want it to feel bigger, bolder, and more intense, so please keep the feedback coming as we continue to refine it!

[h3][b]Key Hive Hunt Changes:[/b][/h3][list][*] Players must now carry [b]Timer Operated Atomic Device Canisters (T.O.A.D) Nukes[/b] to each hive and detonate them.
[*] The rest of the squad will need to protect the Nuke carriers to ensure a successful strike.
[*] Spawn tables are getting updated to raise the challenge but be warned: the mode may feel a bit easier until the full changes land in 1.6[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43269229/bc6d49b47581b3f9f6c0261b93fe60facffdc44c.jpg[/img]
[b]Update 1.5 is targeting a late June release[/b], and we’ll keep you posted as development continues.
Until then, stay sharp, aim true, and always remember:

[h3][b]The only good Bug… is a dead Bug.[/b][/h3]

[h2][b]- Project Lead PMO[/b][/h2]

[b]Please be mindful that everything below is subject to change based on the development progress and testing outcomes.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43269229/17cf7e7c5c317c127aa449b5e4aadb8e0062f179.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Hotfix Update 1.4.1 - Patch Notes
notes.content:
Update 1.4.1 will be available for troopers to download now!

This patch is a small collection of fixes. We welcome your feedback and if you want to chat with your fellow troopers, please feel free to join the [url=https://discord.com/invite/starshiptroopersgame][b]Starship Troopers: Extermination Community Discord[/b][/url]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43269229/5966a31475b357db4334788c15c32b4857bce260.jpg[/img]
[h2][b]Gameplay & General Fixes[/b][/h2]
[list][*] Lead Lined Plates no longer stack damage reduction after each death.
[*] The Broadcast FedNet Field Report beacon is now interactable.
[*] Players should now be able to ping correctly while holding the FedNet Camera.
[*] Thermo Charge animation should now play correctly after each trigger.
[*] Interrupting a grenade throw no longer triggers cooldown without throwing the grenade.
[*] Resolved chat display issues after disabling Cross-Play on console.
[*] Tiger and other bugs now spawn correctly during the final encounter in SOG Mission 5.
[*] Fixed an issue where being incapacitated as a horde wave ends caused a broken state.
[*] Fixed a crash with login.[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.4 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Update 1.4 will be available for troopers to download tomorrow[b] May 7th, 2025 at 10 AM PT (GMT-7).
[/b]
This patch is a collection of content such as the Underbarrel Shotgun and Fednet camera, performance, and optimization improvements as well as bug fixes. If you'd like to discuss Update 1.4 with your fellow troopers, please feel free to join the [url=https://discord.com/invite/starshiptroopersgame][b]Starship Troopers: Extermination Community Discord[/b][/url]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43269229/0f7bd3125d798978cf93379569e2c24756468243.jpg[/img]
[h2][b]Client Performance Improvements[/b][/h2][list][*] Fix a resource pooling bug where rockets would not go to "sleep" when repooling.
[*] Fix a resource pooling bug causing Inferno bugs not to properly go to "sleep" when being pooled.
[*]Reduced ragdoll lifespan.
[*]Optimizations to Chem grenade VFX.[/list][h2][b]Map Performance Improvements[/b][/h2][list][*] A pass has been done on sublevels for Agni Prime and Valaka. Sublevels should now be more aggressively unloaded.[/list][h2][b]Server Performance Improvements[/b][/h2][list][*] Optimizations for Bug pathing: Bugs should now have an easier time finding paths to targets.
[*] Optimizations to Bug locomotion.[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43269229/2b8cdbfd9c09a9cf77cbea1234ab5158a1d2b3cc.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]Bleeding Out & Death Visibility[/b][/h2]
We’ve made improvements to the visibility of Bleeding Out and Death states. Squadmates will have a better awareness of their health status. When incapacitated, a Bleeding Out icon and depleting bar will indicate how much time is remaining to rescue your fellow trooper. When it’s too late to save them, a skull icon will be displayed denoting their death.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43269229/944e8c4a4749a7efc7f349e7c37fa7e3ca0d1407.png[/img]
[h2][b]XP Feed[/b][/h2]
The Experience feed will automatically condense simultaneous Xp events by collapsing them into a single entry. This change is to help reduce the noisy feedback when using explosives with groups of bugs or destroying large quantities of bug Eggs, as the XP Feed would often quickly become overwhelmed and take a very long time to catch up.

[h2][b]Broadcast Heroism[/b][/h2]
[h3][b]FedNet News Broadcast Camera[/b][/h3]
Troopers will be able to recover these FedNet Cameras during their regular combat missions. Equipping them puts the trooper behind the lens, letting them frame the action and provide boosts to their fellow soldiers. 

Simply point at a future war hero-in-the-making, and voila! As you document their actions, you’ll receive LIVE Approval rating updates from the citizens and civilians back home!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43269229/93e6cb664a96868a2a7989421c7d7c73f363cb0a.jpg[/img]
Maintaining Approval ratings benefits us all - but most importantly our troopers on the battlefield. Approved broadcasts provide boosted XP gains for all troopers near a FedNet Camera or who are featured directly in the feed. More heroic actions, generate higher approval, and provide larger boosts to troopers.

Stay tuned for special FedNet News Side Objectives, or keep your eyes peeled for recoverable FedNet Cameras out in the field.

[h2][b]Armory Tuning[/b][/h2]
[h3][b]TW-201-S Morita I[/b][/h3]
The venerable Morita is receiving the underbarrel shotgun. This new weapon modification adds a shotgun as a secondary fire mode. While powerful, it is limited in ammo capacity and range, best utilized as a cqc complement to the Morita instead of a full-replacement to the dedicated shotgun weapons.[list][*] Renamed [b]Morita MK1[/b] → [b]TW-201-S Morita I[/b]
[*] Added Underbarrel Shotgun internal mod at [b]Level 6[/b][/list][h3][b]TW-244-C Morita Carbine[/b][/h3]
Because the Carbine is not receiving an underbarrel attachment, it is given a moderate damage increase to keep it relevant. These changes will improve the close and mid range damage, with a slight reduction at longer ranges.[list][*] Renamed [b]Morita MK1 Carbine[/b] → [b]TW-244-C Morita Carbine[/b]
[*] Damage increased from [b]40 [/b]→ [b]44[/b]
[*] Range increased, medium range increased from [b]50m [/b]→ [b]72m[/b]
[*] Damage falloff adjusted, min damage at 100m reduced from [b]20 [/b]→ [b]17.6[/b][/list][h3][b]TDW-99 Morita Tactical SMG[/b][/h3]
The SMG is receiving a few improvements to maintain its status as the paragon of point-blank damage. These changes improve the base damage and add an additional reserve magazine, reducing the overall damage falloff. Damage is improved at very close ranges, but it will fall off sooner and sharper.[list][*] Damage increased from [b]45 [/b]→ [b]50[/b]
[*] Ammo increased from [b]350 [/b]→ [b]400[/b]
[*] Range reduced, medium range reduced from [b]40m [/b]→ [b]36m[/b]
[*] Range reduced, long-range reduced from [b]80m [/b]→ [b]54m[/b]
[*] Damage falloff adjusted, minimum damage at 110m increased from [b]4.5 [/b]→[b] 7.5[/b][/list][h3][b]TW-2 Sp.L.I.T Shotguns[/b][/h3]
Split shotguns have been given with new model designations.[list][*] Renamed [b]TW-2 SP.L.I.T Shotgun (Slug)[/b] → [b]TW-2-R Sp.L.I.T Shotgun (Slug)[/b]
[*] Renamed [b]TW-2 SP.L.I.T Shotgun (Auto)[/b] → [b]TW-2-FA Sp.L.I.T Shotgun (Auto)[/b][/list][h3][b](Galactic Perk) Fighting Retreat[/b][/h3]
In the heat of battle, it was difficult to discern when Fighting Retreat was actually active. To improve player feedback an icon will now be displayed on the HUD while active and a cue will indicate when it activates.[h3][b]Scan Pulse[/b][/h3]
Scan Pulse will now automatically activate when selected. This change only affects PC users when using keyboard and mouse.[h3][b]LV Visor[/b][/h3]
LV Visor will now automatically activate when selected. This change only affects PC users when using keyboard and mouse.

[h2][b]Arachnid Tuning[/b][/h2]
[h3][b]Gunner[/b][/h3]
Gunners are receiving a reduction in accuracy. They were previously far too deadly at long range and also exploitable using partial cover due to their laser-focused shots. Gunners should now give players a fair chance to react at long range and still be very effective at close range, and shoot better at troopers in partial cover. [list][*] Decreased accuracy from [b]4 MOA/0.06 degrees deviation[/b] → [b]150 MOA/2.5 degrees deviation[/b]
[*] Increase per-shot damage from [b]5[/b] → [b]7.5[/b][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43269229/5966a31475b357db4334788c15c32b4857bce260.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]Known Issues[/b][/h2][list][*] Tanker bug has inconsistent damage with its spray attack.
[*] AI trooper side objectives have been temporarily disabled in our ARC game mode while we address the server instability with these new recruits. We have an optimization planned for this in our 1.5 update in June.
[*] The Demolisher Servos perk not doing damage when trying to melee.[/list]
[h2][b]Highlights [/b][/h2][list]
[*] Fixed an issue that allowed Engineers using the Mobile Build Tool ability to build in unintended locations, atop unintended troopers, and on unintended terrain.
[*] Fixed an issue where players were able to overwrite their primary weapons by picking up utilities while their inventory was full. 
[*] The legs of the Warriors, Drones and Gunners should now properly take damage from weapons.[/list]
[h2][b]Console Fixes[/b][/h2][list][*] Fixed an issue where players would respawn where they died due to connection issues. 
[*] Fixed an issue where using the Right Bumper (RB) to rotate a building blueprint will cause the player to throw a grenade.
[*] Fixed an issue where the On Use utilities would make it difficult to swap utilities while on controller.[/list]
[h2][b] UI[/b][/h2][list][*] Fixed an issue that caused the Revive timers and Bleeding Out indicators on the HUD to disappear.
[*] Fixed a bug where all factions appeared as "Demon" when opening the scoreboard.
[*] Fixed missing 'Toggle Spotlight' text in the Spotlight hover prompt.
[*] Fixed flickering issue on Galactic Front reward text.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Secondary Fire mode tutorial pop-up did not appear.
[*] Fixed a bug where the Social screen and prompts would not close, allowing the player to gain control behind the menus.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Tactical map would center itself when zooming in or out using a controller.
[*] Fixed incorrect text strings used during the building process.
[*] Fixed the missing scroll bar button from the loadout weapon list.
[*] Fixed unlocalized text and graphics in the Galactic Front description (Z bind).
[*] Fixed an issue where English text appeared on the Settings Menu after successfully changing to another language.
[*] Fixed a bug where the Company chat input window closed when a new player joined the company.
[*] Fixed unclear error message displayed when sending a request to a company capped on join requests.
[*] Fixed high-priority target notification in match displaying in English.
[*] Fixed various non-localized in-match messages.
[*] Fixed English text appearing in new weapon modifications for Guardian, Medic, Sniper, Demolisher, and Engineer classes.
[*] Fixed English tooltip text about the loadout locker.
[*] Fixed grammatical issue caused by two strings being glued together in French and other languages.
[*] Fixed an issue where Chinese characters were cut off in the weapon level-up message on the end match screen.[/list]
[h2][b]Audio[/b][/h2][list][*] Fixed an issue where players joining Horde Mode mid-wave would experience missing background music.
[*] Fixed a bug causing close-range explosion sound effects not to play at certain distances.
[*] Fixed an issue where Trooper pain sound effects could clip when taking repeated damage in quick succession.
[*] Fixed missing footstep audio when traversing tunnels on Agni Prime.
[*] Fixed a bug where explosion visual and sound effects would trigger prematurely before Chem Grenades detonated on impact.
[*] Fixed an issue causing third-person weapon audio to be significantly quieter than intended.
[*] Art & Animation
[*] Fixed overly bright dust effects when playing during night missions and Pitch Black missions.
[*] Fixed an issue where grenades appeared incorrectly attached to troopers in the Edit Loadout preview screen.
[*] Fixed a bug causing incoming plasma bombardment sound effects to be excessively loud at long distances.
[*] Fixed an issue where the player’s shadow did not display slashing animations when performing melee attacks.
[*] Fixed specific grenades appearing rotated incorrectly on the hips of the Engineer, Medic, Guardian, and Demolisher classes.
[*] Fixed a Scorch dialogue line after spotting a Royal that did not match its subtitle.
[*] Fixed the Federation logo being upside down on closed doors in the X-11 map.
[*] Fixed an issue where players could pull out a second utility item during the Scan Pulse animation.
[*] Fixed an animation mismatch between the knife attack and its visual animation.
[*] Fixed a missing render soldier in the SOG Voice Pack selection screen.[/list]
[h2][b]Gameplay & General Fixes[/b][/h2][list][*] Fixed an issue that allowed Deployable utilities to be placed on Dropped items.
[*] Fixed an issue that allowed Deployable utilities to be placed inside the MBU.
[*] Fixed an issue that could replace equipped weapons with utilities from crates and fabricators.
[*] Fixed an issue that granted incorrect XP for scanning bugs with the Scan Dart.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Supercapacitor weapon mod did not reduce fire rate or increase punchthrough damage of the E-Pulse 44 A2 when equipped in a mission.
[*] Fixed an issue allowing players to highlight Scan Pulse while the buff was already active.
[*] Fixed players becoming stuck inside structures when standing within a blueprint while building.
[*] Fixed Dart utilities not resupplying at ammo crates.
[*] Fixed players being unable to throw grenades while holding a utility after canceling a grenade throw for the first time.
[*] Fixed grenade cooldown animations continuing after changing classes via the Gear Locker.
[*] Fixed an exploit where grenades could be thrown an unlimited number of times after picking up Turret Ammo.
[*] Fixed an issue where grenade cooldowns would reset after a player was revived.
[*] Fixed squad members in S.O.G. missions not correctly considering the maximum effective range of flamethrowers.
[*] Fixed the Morita XXX Sniper Rifle not dealing damage to bugs at close range.
[*] Fixed certain bugs not consistently taking damage from lava on Agni Prime.
[*] Fixed bugs spawning during the build phase on the Horde_Boreas_North map.
[*] Fixed Gunner Bugs briefly appearing above ground before completing their spawn animation.
[*] Fixed bugs struggling to navigate new environment changes on Valaka.
[*] Fixed Napalm and Lava not damaging bugs when their heads were above the surface level.
[*] Fixed screen jittering when Troopers were near nuke planting locations.
[*] Fixed cliffs behind the Victory Bridge appearing and disappearing when moving back and forth.
[*] Fixed troopers clipping through walls and seeing backface meshes near the ARC_Garage.
[*] Fixed missing kill volume beneath the bridge in southeastern Valaka.
[*] Fixed an issue where players could fall under environmental objects in S.O.G. Mission 4 without an escape path.
[*] Fixed the ARC_Admin area displaying the Fuel Depot description instead of the correct Admin sub-area.
[*] Fixed AAS_Starport2 and AAS_Starport3 intro and scoreboard showing the Hospital sub-area instead of the correct one.
[*] Fixed the Scan Dart incorrectly awarding the first +2 XP after scanning only one or two bugs.
[*] Fixed AI troopers in S.O.G. Mission 9 failed to recognize when players moved ahead of them.
[*] Fixed an issue where players could enter a desynced state by attempting to take an item from a fabricator twice rapidly.
[*] Fixed a bug where downed players appeared to regenerate health from the perspective of squadmates.
[*] Fixed an issue where players could sometimes revive immediately in place without costing a respawn ticket.
[*] Fixed an issue where melee attacks against enemies or corpses caused Troopers to stop animating and their weapon to disappear.[/list]

notes.title: Federation Preview: The Underbarrel and the FedNet Camera
notes.content:
[h2][b]Attention, Citizens and Future Infantry![/b][/h2]

The Federation grants you an exclusive first look at the latest battlefield enhancements, ensuring our brave troopers maintain absolute superiority over the Arachnid threat.

We want you to be ready for what FAS Research and Development has been working on, so we have released this preview. Let's begin, shall we?

The [b]Morita Mk1 Underbarrel Shotgun[/b] is designed for close-quarters combat efficiency, delivering devastating firepower at point-blank range. When facing a Bug swarm in tight tunnels or urban engagements, a single blast clears the way for uninterrupted extermination. Chambered for high-impact rounds, this attachment guarantees maximum lethality with minimal engagement time. Want to get up close and personal with a Warrior Bug? This is your new best friend.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43269229/d1cecef19648e23bda78e6b81bf7e457ed5fdf68.jpg[/img]
Hear from our R&D team and the designer of the Underbarrel on what they have to say about the project and arming fellow troopers:

While the Morita Mk1 rifles deployed to the Mobile Infantry at large have long featured an underbarrel attachment, the DSV initially deployed to the Valaka Campaign with a stock of Moritas that dropped the iconic underbarrel shotgun. Testing simulations showed that this variant felt more accurate to troopers, and the lack of extra firepower wasn’t missed. 

That quickly changed when boots hit the ground, and our brave Vanguard troopers began staring down the jaws of Archie Warriors as sandstorms swirled around them. Vanguard Troopers started demanding their shotguns back to help fend off the Arachnid Menace, and after following all appropriate logistical protocols, DSV Command has answered. To make sure that the limited stock of Morita Mk1s with Underbarrels doesn’t disappear rapidly, DSV Command is authorizing deployment to more experienced troopers. This quick thinking by Command has reduced trooper field casualties by a spectacular 3%.

Troopers who have a Morita Mk1 Weapon Mastery 6 or greater will be able to attach an underbarrel to their rifle via the loadout menu. The underbarrel comes with a 4-round internal tube as well as 8 additional shells for reload at the cost of one of your traditional Morita Mk1 magazines. Additionally, the extra weight of the Underbarrel causes the weapon to be a bit heavy on the frontend causing it to be a bit more inaccurate when firing on the move or from a standing position. 

“We worked alongside the Morita corporation to develop a whole new lightweight variant for the classic Morita rifle specifically for the DSV. But upon identifying unforeseen performance issues in the field, we had to figure out a way to bring back what troopers loved about the shotgun attached to the older model and make it work for the newer model at only 98.7% of the previous materials weight. What some may see as a redundant expenditure of department funds, I see as succeeding twice…” - [b]RnD[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43269229/7a1c7bf42c0dc758073b5328912ab557573737de.jpg[/img]
Meanwhile, the [b]FedNet Camera[/b] ensures that every heroic moment of Mobile Infantry action is documented. These battlefield-hardened, and combat-tested broadcast units provide state of the newsreel feeds directly to the Federal Network and all our loyal citizens back home. Not only does this aid in battlefield analysis, and training, but it also ensures every citizen can witness the heroic deeds of our valiant Mobile Infantry and give our troopers an extra morale boost in the field!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43269229/f273ed60d43a1c42c8379a15a07fd0fc2660c905.jpg[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43269229/828fd80a3f498f0dabeef86894a3386ce783e719.jpg[/img]

Due to logistical complexities, and regrettable deployment security incidents, our Vanguard Troopers will be able to recover these FedNet Cameras during their regular combat missions. Equipping them puts the trooper behind the lens, letting them frame the action and provide boosts to their fellow soldiers. Simply point at a future war hero-in-the-making, and voila! As you document their actions, you’ll receive LIVE Approval rating updates from the citizens and civilians back home!

Maintaining Approval ratings benefits us all - but most importantly our troopers on the battlefield. Approved broadcasts provide boosted XP gains for all troopers near a FedNet Camera or who are featured directly in the feed. More heroic actions, generate higher approval, and provide larger boosts to troopers.

“The Federation is extremely satisfied with our engineer’s fast work in adapting decades-old technology for deployment on the frontlines. This breakthrough is a testament to our technical superiority over the Bugs, only we could create something so reasonably user-friendly and man-portable that any M.I. grunt could handle it. It requires only the dedicated use of both hands and the Trooper’s full care and attention. Due to risk of sudden immolation, Troopers are reminded to avoid direct gunfire and explosives near an operating FedNet Camera.” – [b]Omni[/b]

───

We hope you all enjoyed this preview of the much-asked-for Underbarrel for the Morita Mk1. We can't wait for you to get your hands on it, and we hope to see you exterminate those bugs more efficiently!

Want to chat with like minded troopers on the equipment you'll soon use on the battlefield? Well we welcome you to join the [url=https://discord.com/invite/starshiptroopersgame][b]Starship Troopers: Extermination Community Discord[/b][/url]! 

[h2][b]See you around troopers![/b][/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1268750/Starship_Troopers_Extermination/

notes.title: Starship Troopers: Extermination Development Update (April 4th, 2025)
notes.content:
[h2][b]Hello fellow Troopers![/b][/h2]

First and foremost, let’s take a moment to catch our breath now that Quarter 1 is officially behind us. What a hectic and productive quarter it has been for all of us! We’ve been hard at work, and I’m proud to say that we successfully released two major patches during this period. These updates not only addressed a variety of bugs but also included numerous optimizations that have helped improve the overall gaming experience. We also introduced exciting new features, such as the staged reload, Galactic Perks, and weather effects, just to name a few. But I want to stress—this is only the beginning! We’ve got so much more in store for the future, and Quarter 2 is shaping up to be just as thrilling.

So, what can we expect from Quarter 2? Let’s dive into what’s coming up next:

[b]Update 1.4[/b] is currently scheduled for release in mid-May. This update will focus on optimizing bug pathing, which means our Bugs will behave better on the navigation mesh and get stuck less often in the environment. We’ve also heard your feedback, and we’re excited to introduce the highly requested [b]Fednet Heroism feature[/b], as well as the often talked-about[b] underbarrel attachment for the Morita MK1[/b]. These additions will provide more tactical options and enhancements to your gameplay experience.

WIP of capturing some cool Agni weather

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43269229/d92e011e974c745558545216d74390acedf0df12.png[/img]
Now, let’s take a sneak peek at [b]Update 1.5[/b]:

In Update 1.5, we are hard at work bringing the[b] Morita MK2 Weapon[/b] to the game a weapon briefly featured in the films. This addition will give you a new, powerful way to take on the Arachnid menace.

But that’s not all. [b]Phase 1[/b] of the Galactic Front changes will also be coming in Update 1.5. We’ve gathered a ton of feedback regarding the Galactic Front, especially around accessibility and the process of launching and playing Company Operations. With these changes, we’ll be removing the need for companies to purchase Company Ops. Instead, Company Ops will now be available in the Play menu as a rotating list of operations that are tied to certain milestones. Additionally, we’ll be adding a Quickplay option specifically for Company Ops, making it even easier to jump into the action. Intel will still be gathered through general missions, and in [b]Phase 2[/b], later this year, Intel will become the primary currency for leveling up and expanding your Company’s size and customization options. We’ll have more details on Phase 1 changes in a June developer blog, so stay tuned!

Current WIP for new Match Selection Screen coming in 1.5

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43269229/64ab37e37da7e7ee1bd8bc6ba3118103bb1100ae.png[/img]
Lastly, we’re excited to introduce our [b]Dynamic Sky System to X-11[/b], and we’ll continue to refine and improve this feature over time. I forgot one last thing, we’ve also got a little surprise planned for Update 1.5 that will make you rethink your approach to a certain game mode.

That’s all for this month, Troopers! We’ll talk again soon, but in the meantime, we’ll see you in-game!

[h3][b]Peter Maurice, OWI_PMO[/b][/h3]

Please be mindful that everything below is subject to change based on the development progress and testing outcomes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43269229/21c3879bfb0d6f0eecf0fb39a6f6892af82ee1cf.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Update 1.3 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Update 1.3 will be available for troopers to download at [b]10 AM PT (GMT-7)[/b] on [b]March 24th, 2025[/b].

This patch is a collection of content, performance, and optimization improvements and bug fixes. If you'd like to discuss Update 1.3 with your fellow troopers, please feel free to join the [url=https://discord.com/invite/starshiptroopersgame][b]Starship Troopers: Extermination Community Discord[/b][/url]!

[b]PLEASE NOTE[/b] With this update your settings will have been reset. Please take the time to go through your settings if needed! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43269229/2b8cdbfd9c09a9cf77cbea1234ab5158a1d2b3cc.jpg[/img]
[h2][b]Staged Weapon Reloads[/b][/h2]
All weapons, except for the Sp.L.I.T Shotgun and Sp.L.I.T Shotgun (Slug), now feature distinct reload stages. This means that if your reload is interrupted for any reason, resuming it will pick up from the most recent checkpoint. No more restarting the entire animation every time it's interrupted!

Checkpoints occur at key moments in the reload process, such as removing a magazine, inserting a new one, or charging the weapon. Additionally, when you remove a gun’s ammo source, its remaining ammo will either drop to 0 or 1 to reflect that the magazine has been taken out.[list][*] Weapons that drop to 0 ammo (e.g., the FU-17) must complete the reload before they can fire again.
[*] Weapons that retain 1 round in the chamber (e.g., the Mk1) allow you to fire that last shot, but you'll need to reload before firing any more rounds.[/list]This long-awaited quality-of-life improvement the community has asked for and should make reloading feel much smoother and more intuitive. We’re excited to finally bring this change to the game.
[h2][b]Ultra Dynamic Sky/Weather[/b][/h2]
Valaka, Boreas, and Agni Prime now have Day & Night cycles and Dynamic Weather. This means troopers will experience an always changing environment as they battle the bugs; be it the darkness of night, an emergent duststorm, or a sudden rain shower! Each planet has their own variety of weather systems which will add new challenges for troopers to contend with.

In addition to the idle weather, we have introduced Extreme Weather Mutators. The existing Sandstorm Mutator has been adjusted to include more variation in intensity rolling between mildly obscured, to significantly blinding. In addition to sandstorms, Troopers will have to contend with new Mutators as well; such as dramatic thunderstorms, freezing blizzards, and choking ashstorms.

The new Dynamic Weather and Day & Night cycles allows us to bring the oft-beloved (occasionally dreaded) Pitch Black Mutator to more planets. Pitch Black throws the Troopers into a terrifying fight in the dark. Keep those Light Beacons and Flashlights close!

Missions with these extreme weather conditions will be included in the regular Mission rotation.
[h2][b]Game XP for Disconnections[/b][/h2]
Players will now earn XP if they disconnect due to crashes or server disconnections. However, players marked as traitors will not receive XP for disconnecting.
[h2][b]Invite Friends to Your Company[/b][/h2]
Players can now invite others to their company directly from the player profile modal. Additionally, players can request to join or join a company through the same modal, even without an invite.
[h2][b]Weapon Mods[/b][/h2]
We have added two mods for the Sp.L.I.T Shotgun
[list][*] Speed Loader is now available on both Sp.L.I.T variants.
[*] Fast Rack Mechanisms is now available on the Sp.L.I.T slug.[/list][h2][b]Gameplay Tuning[/b][/h2]
[h3][b]Pilum Surplus[/b][/h3]
The Pilum Surplus Mutator has been changed to support more player choice. The Mutator will no longer replace every Trooper’s primary weapon, instead requiring Troopers to acquire the M-56 Pilum Rocket Launchers from MI Crates. A limited number of these crates can now be found hidden around the mission area.
[h3][b]Dart Utility[/b][/h3]
Darts (Stim/Scan) now draw from your Utility Ammo and interact with the perks Utility Utilization and Utility Satchel instead of Bandolier.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43269229/644fcbd088b3a7933c47f86c9a6d60fa3a99a37f.jpg[/img]
[h2][b]Client Performance Improvements[/b][/h2]
[list][*] Bug rendering performance has been improved. GPU frame time is now independent of the number of bugs on screen.
[*] Nuclear explosions are now properly culled, reducing their average frame time cost by around 40%.
[*] Inferno Bug explosions and fire effects have been optimized for better performance.
[*] Epic settings now default to Lumen Software, with Lumen Hardware remaining optional.
[*] Hive Hunt eggs have been optimized.
[*] Sparks from damaged buildings are now properly culled based on view and distance, improving performance.
[*] Optimizations to the Box Collider for Bug attack hit detection.[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43269229/bdce70c237e0e8a9ff494b1e373f027aeba8fc0d.jpg[/img]
[h2][b]Known Issues[/b][/h2]
[list][*] For Steam Deck users, switching between Performance and Quality mode on Steam Deck during a match may cause the game to crash. This feature is currently in Alpha and will be improved upon in future updates.[/list][h2][b]Highlights [/b][/h2][list][*] Add new Steam Deck specific Video settings, Performance and Quality - This is in Alpha for Steam Deck users. We hope to improve this in future updates.
