notes.title: Starship Troopers: Extermination Development Update (March 7th, 2025)
notes.content:
[h2][b]Hello Troopers,[/b][/h2]

Spring is in the air, which means it’s March—and time for another Development Update!

First, a quick message from [b]Sky Marshall Ramsey[/b]:

“Attention, Deep Space Vanguard: The Disputed Sands front is not progressing as we had hoped. Let me remind you all: failure is not an option. Get in there and do your part—we cannot afford to surrender Valaka to the Bug!”

Now, onto the next big release: [b]Update 1.3[/b]. This update will be packed with optimizations, bug fixes, and highly requested features. The big surprise is the introduction of our dynamic sky and weather systems! Stay tuned for more news around this update through all the normal social channels.
While we don't have an exact release date yet, we expect the update to arrive around the end of March or early April. As we get closer to finalizing the date, we’ll share more details on Discord and the Steam forums.

[b]What's next? Well, there's a lot coming your way![/b]

With [b]Update 1.4[/b], we're excited to introduce the [b]Underbarrel Attachment[/b] for the Morita MK1. This has been one of the most requested weapon attachments since the game debuted in early access. It wasn't an easy task reworking our weapon system to add this secondary firing mode, but the effort has paid off. Thanks to this update, we're also able to introduce the [b]Morita MK2[/b] and [b]Morita MK3[/b] later this year. Plus, it opens the door to the possibility of adding secondary firing mods for other weapons in the future.

Now, what's next? Here's something fun that we've kept under wraps for a while! We've had many requests for a [b]Cameraman/women[/b] class, and I personally believe that these men and women are some of the bravest Troopers in the history of the Federation. We wanted to give our Troopers the Cameraman/women fantasy while still staying true to our combat-first structure. We've chosen a solution that we believe satisfies the role and provides an invaluable benefit worthy of setting aside their Morita.

In [b]Update 1.4[/b], we’re introducing [b]Broadcast Heroism[/b]—an opportunity for players to step into the role of a cameraman for the Federation. Troopers will have the opportunity to recover [b]Federal Network Broadcast Cameras[/b] in the field and wield them to film their fellow Troopers as they battle the Bugs. While filming, it’s important for Troopers to protect the cameraman, Broadcasting heroic feats for the Federal Network provides an Morale XP Booster for Troopers on the battlefield. Cameras will begin appearing as Side Objectives in ARC and Horde, and can be found hidden around the battlefield in other game modes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43269229/a380dc1fce8c27c623594a05788704a6f7a90da3.jpg[/img]
The community's passion and enthusiasm inspire us every day to keep improving and creating the best experience possible. We look forward to seeing you in the game and sharing many more incredible moments together. Thank you once again, from the bottom of our hearts. 

[b]See you in-game![/b]

[h3][b]Peter Maurice, OWI_PMO[/b][/h3]

Please be mindful that everything below is subject to change based on the development progress and testing outcomes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43269229/d1cb2ba75e3080b3c21e5b1194b8196a69b7e595.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Starship Troopers: Extermination Development Update (February 7th, 2025)
notes.content:
[h2][b]Hello Starship Troopers: Extermination Community![/b][/h2]

Wow, can you believe it’s already February? Time flies when you're battling Bugs in the Federation! We’ve been busy working behind the scenes, and I wanted to take a moment to update you all on a few things.

[h3][b]Hero of the Federation Difficulty:[/b][/h3]

First up, let’s talk about the Hero of the Federation difficulty. We released it to our closed Beta group, and to put it simply, the reception was… mixed. Our fantastic Beta testers gave us tons of valuable feedback, and after reviewing it all, we’ve decided to pull it back and spend some more time improving it.

The consensus was clear: while the difficulty ramp-up was not noticeable, it didn’t quite deliver the challenge we were hoping for. Some testers felt it didn’t feel much more challenging than Hard mode. We’ve always been committed to making this new difficulty more than just a stat increase for the Bugs, no one wants bullet sponge enemies. To that end, we’re introducing new mechanics and refining some core systems to make it a true challenge. We’re going to keep working on it, and once we have the adjustments ready, we’ll send it back to our Beta testers to make sure we’re on the right track. Stay tuned for future updates as we work to make it the thrilling experience we’ve promised.

[h3][b]UI Optimizations:[/b][/h3]

Now, on to something we’ve been focused on for a while: performance improvements. As I’ve mentioned in previous updates, optimizing and fixing bugs is a priority for us, and version 1.3 is no exception. One of the most noticeable changes you’ll find is a significant UI optimization. The interface should now feel much snappier and more responsive, whether you're in the heat of gameplay or navigating the menus. This should make everything feel smoother and more enjoyable.

[h3][b]A Special Surprise in 1.3:[/b][/h3]

I’ve mentioned this feature/system many times before on live streams, and I’ve been eagerly waiting for the day we could finally get it in-game. Well, that day is here, and I’m thrilled to announce that we’ve added something I find absolutely really cool to the game (though, let’s be real, I’m biased). I don’t want to hype it up too much, but it’s something I’ve wanted for a long time, and I’m sure it’ll be something you’ll love, too. You’ll see it in 1.3, Time of Day shifts and dynamic weather is coming to the game. I can’t wait to hear what you think. While the Bugs and weapons will always be the stars of the show, I truly believe our planets deserve some love too, and this new feature is a step toward that!  As we get closer to release 1.3 in March (tentative release window) we will be talking more about real time weather, Below is a glimpse into the new system. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43269229/9ee6ae158b10836953b27d856320b02e341fbd7a.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43269229/0f0f0692ed9279d2cf06e11f8ed8ac4d7bb33b34.png[/img]
Lastly, I just want to take a moment to thank all of you for your continued support. Your feedback, enthusiasm, and dedication mean the world to us. We couldn’t do this without you, and as always, we’re working hard to make Starship Troopers: Extermination the best it can be. Stay tuned for more updates and keep those Bug-squashing boots on!

[b]Until next time, and keep fighting the good fight,[/b]

[h3][b]Peter Maurice, OWI_PMO[/b][/h3]

Please be mindful that everything below is subject to change based on the development progress and testing outcomes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43269229/9ec643b2c2a0f6b85fa86a6a9746e5b285b96174.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Announcing Update 1.2: Disputed Sands
notes.content:
Offworld is happy to announce that Update 1.2 for Starship Troopers: Extermination will be released on [b]February 5th at 10 AM GMT-7.[/b] 

Below is a quick summary of what our troopers on the field can expect in Update 1.2.

[h2][b]A New Galactic Front[/b][/h2]
As the Federation reigns victorious on Boreas a new Galactic Front is here. Disputed Sands will bring troopers back to Valaka with new milestones, rewards, and Bugs to kill! Disputed Sands will go live alongside the release of Update 1.2 for both PC and Console. Form your companies, bring the fight to those Bugs and reign victorious!

[h2][b]New Weapon Mods[/b][/h2]
Federation Research and Development has been hard at work improving trooper weaponry and their latest breakthroughs are ready to hit the field. State-of-the-art weapon modifications have been approved and are now available for a selection of weapons.

Be among the first to gear up with these cutting-edge mods and show the enemy what Federation ingenuity looks like.

[h2][b]Company Chat[/b][/h2]
The battlefield isn’t won alone. Communication and coordination with your squad just got a major upgrade! Introducing the Company Chat feature now found in the Company Home Page. Rally your squad, share intel, and prepare for the next mission. The fight’s better when we stand together.

[h2][b]Re-Enlistment Rewards[/b][/h2]
Re-enlistment just got a whole lot sharper. Those who step up for another tour of duty will be rewarded with exclusive cosmetics to showcase their dedication. The Prestige Set awaits Tier 1 Re-enlistees – a visual statement of your commitment, including sleek new looks for your uniform, visor, weapon, and more.

Already re-enlisted? Don't worry – your recognition is retroactive.

Get ready to stand apart, Troopers. More details await you in the field and when our patch notes release. See you on the frontlines.

───

We want to give a big thank you to all our loyal Troopers for your continued support and feedback – it’s what helps us improve the fight for the Federation. If you’re already enlisted, we’d love to hear from you! Drop us a review on Steam and let us know how we’re doing.

And if you’re ready to take charge and start building your own company of elite Troopers, join the fight on the  [url=https://discord.com/invite/starshiptroopersgame][b]Starship Troopers: Extermination Community Discord[/b][/url]. Meet your fellow trooopers, share strategies, and rally your squad before deployment!

The Federation thanks you, Troopers! For feedback, for unity, and for keeping the frontlines strong!

[h2][b]See you on Valaka Troopers, Kill ‘em All! [/b][/h2]

notes.title: Starship Troopers: Extermination Development Update (January 14, 2025)
notes.content:
[h2][b]Dear Starship Troopers Community,[/b][/h2]

As we step into the new year, we want to take a moment to thank each and every one of you for your unwavering support and passion for Starship Troopers: Extermination. The past months have been filled with exciting moments, and as we look ahead to the next three months, we are more committed than ever to making Starship Troopers: Extermination a game that you can continue to enjoy and evolve with.

[h3][b]Looking Ahead: PC & Console Optimization, Bug Fixes, and Quality of Life Improvements[/b][/h3]

Over the next three months, we will be focusing heavily on optimizing Starship Troopers: Extermination for both PC and console. Our goal is to ensure the game performs as smoothly as possible across all platforms, providing a seamless experience for every trooper in the Federation. We will also continue addressing quality of life issues to enhance the overall gameplay experience.
Alongside this, we are prioritizing the fixing of bugs and addressing any pain points that the community has raised. Your feedback has been invaluable, and we are committed to constantly listening to you. Please keep sharing your thoughts on our forums, social media, and in-game, as your voices are crucial to our development process.

[h3][b]A Huge Congratulations to the Community for the New Frontier Event[/b][/h3]

We’d also like to extend our heartfelt congratulations to the community for the monumental success in our first-ever Galactic Front event! Thanks to your hard work and dedication, we’ve successfully established a foothold on Boreas for the Federation, paving the way for future missions and challenges. You’ve shown that, together, we can accomplish anything.

[h3][b]The Galactic Front & the 1.2 Update - Coming in February[/b][/h3]

Looking ahead, we are thrilled to announce that Starship Troopers will be introducing the new Galactic Front event, Disputed Sands, with the release of [b]Update 1.2[/b] in early February. This exciting new chapter will introduce the Galactic Perks system—an all-new rewards system designed to give players more ways to advance and customize their troopers to their playstyle. Expect more details about this system later this month, but rest assured, it will give you new incentives to continue your heroic efforts in the fight for the Federation.

We can’t wait for you to experience all of this and more in the coming months. We are immensely proud of this community and everything we have accomplished together. With your continued feedback and support, we’ll continue to shape Starship Troopers: Extermination into the ultimate experience for all of us.

Thank you for being part of this incredible journey, and stay tuned for more updates soon!

[b]For the Federation,[/b]

[h3][b]Peter Maurice, OWI_PMO[/b][/h3]

Please be mindful that everything below is subject to change based on the development progress and testing outcomes.

notes.title: Update 1.1 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Update 1.1 will be available for troopers to download [b]November 13th, 2024[/b] at [b]10 AM PT (GMT-7)[/b].

This patch is a collection of content, performance, and optimization improvements and bug fixes. If you'd like to discuss Update 1.1 with your fellow troopers, please feel free to join the [url=https://discord.com/invite/starshiptroopersgame][b]Starship Troopers: Extermination Community Discord[/b][/url]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43269229/0f7bd3125d798978cf93379569e2c24756468243.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]Client Performance Improvements[/b][/h2]
[list][*] Optimizations to Trooper deaths as weapons and inventory items were causing match performance degradation.
[*] Optimization for Beacons: Replace Beacon Skeletal anim cycle with vertex animations.
[*] Optimization of Base Ammo Crate skeletal mesh.
[*] Optimization for the following LODs ([i]Changing how detailed objects in the game look based on how far away they are from the player[/i]):
[list] [*] [b]Ammo Boxes[/b]
 [*] [b]S.P.L.I.T Drum Shotgun[/b]
 [*] [b]MG Turrets[/b]
 [*] [b]Morita XXX Sniper Rifle [/b]
 [*] [b]FU-17 Flamethrower[/b][/list][*] Optimizations to the root bones of Gunner Bugs.
[*] Optimizations to the root bones of Tiger Elite Bugs.
[*] Optimizations to the Chaos Physics system on PC.[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43269229/2b8cdbfd9c09a9cf77cbea1234ab5158a1d2b3cc.jpg[/img]
[h2][b]Loadout Locker[/b][/h2]
Troopers! The Loadout Locker is a new feature coming in Update 1.1.

Loadout Lockers can be found at the back of the initial dropship in AAS, ARC, and Hive Hunt. While in Horde, they can be found placed randomly within the build zone for the first [b]2[/b] ([b]two[/b]) waves before self-destructing. The goal of the Loadout Lockers is to allow Trooper to change their loadout early on in games. Now the question might be, why only early on?

Choosing a Loadout, and locking in that choice, is integral to our intended gameplay. Troopers are given incomplete information about the combat situation and they must make choices on the gear they bring. By limiting Loadout changes to the early phases of the mission, we continue to reinforce both a Loadout's strong aspects and weaknesses - while offering a little bit more quality-of-life and flexibility.

We want to ensure that the choice of equipment and class abilities still matter. As the different classes are not equally viable at all stages of the mission; Engineers and Rangers may excel during the opening phases and Ore/Resource running, while Guardians and Demolishers can be invaluable during the final siege. Troopers will need to play smart, improvise constantly, and rely on their teammates to cover their Loadout's shortcomings.

That being said, we've heard you out, and there are absolutely cases that are frustrating in terms of class selection, and most of them happen right at the start of a game. So now, if you join in as a Sniper and there are 15 other Snipers that all select at the same time as you, you can quickly run back to the dropship and switch things up. We think this is a pretty good compromise between the intent of picking and being locked into a loadout, but also allowing players to avoid weird or annoying team compositions for the entire course of a match. 

Troopers need not worry as any XP earned applies to the class and weapon it was earned on. So if you are a Ranger, kill a few bugs with your Morita MK1, and then switch over to a Demolisher with a shotgun for the remainder of the match, at the end of the match you will gain XP on the Ranger and Morita for the few bugs you’ve killed and then you will also gain the rest of the XP on the Demolisher and Shotgun.

[h2][b]Company Stats[/b][/h2]
It's time to track your collective achievements like never before! Our new Company Stats feature gives you high level insight into your Company's accomplishments and showcases the strength of your Company in the fight against the Bug menace. Here's what you can expect:

[b]Intel Gained:[/b] See the total amount of Intel your Company has accumulated, highlighting the strategic prowess of your members as they complete regular missions and contribute to your Company's resources.

[b]Company Operations Completed:[/b] View the number of Company Operations your Company has successfully finished. Whether you're defending the ARC or launching full-scale Assault and Secure missions, this stat tracks every hard-fought victory.

[b]Company Operations Created:[/b] Keep an eye on how many Company Operations have been initiated by your Company Officers. This stat reflects the activity and ambition of your Officers as they strategize to conquer new challenges.

[b]Victory Points Earned:[/b] Your Company's total Victory Points earned in all Galactic Fronts to date, are a true testament to your group's impact on the battlefield. This number captures your Company's success and dedication to conquering every threat.

This is just the beginning! We have plans to roll out even more stats in future updates, giving you deeper insights into your Company's performance. Rally your Company, aim high, and let your accomplishments be known!

[h2][b]Quality-of-Life[/b][/h2]
Weapon mastery has been added to Special Operations Group missions. A player should be able to master one weapon if they choose to by completing all 25 solo missions with that weapon or earn XP on any of the unlocked class weapons as they see fit. Solo missions are repeatable [b]3[/b] ([b]three[/b]) times for Class and Weapon Mastery XP, with diminishing returns for each playthrough.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43269229/5966a31475b357db4334788c15c32b4857bce260.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]Known Issues[/b][/h2]
[list][*] Trophy progress for Bug Kills on PS5 appears stuck.
[*] PS5 players may encounter stuttering on player entry into a match.
[*] Pressing Play and entering a Queue and changing screens to another UI screen will cause the play button to not be functional but will still queue players into a game.
[*] Class Ability UI may disappear but will still function. Redeploy or use the Loadout Locker for it to reappear.[/list][h2][b]Highlights [/b][/h2]
[list][*] Fixed significant performance drops that occurred after Hive Explosions.
[*] Quick Play matchmaking no longer causes an infinite queue time.
[*] Redeploying after respawning no longer causes invincibility.
[*] Settings changes should now save consistently across sessions.
[*] Stims Pistol now revives downed players more reliably.
[*] Tactical SMG bullets now align accurately with the crosshair.
[*] The FU-17 Flamethrower no longer causes screen darkening when used against enemies or allies.
[*] The Engineer’s Mobile Build tool ability should now be easier to use on Boreas
[*] The "Search Company" function now enforces character input limits.
[*] The "Create Rally" callout now appears instead of "Ping" when holding a canister.[/list][h2][b]Console[/b][/h2]
[list][*] The Xbox controller now allows skipping of the intro cutscene.
[*] Fixed an issue where players were unable to scroll through the “Recent” tab list in-game using the Right Stick.
[*] Fixed the arrow icon on the “Suggested Company” screen, which was not functioning when attempting to move to the next page.
[*] Removed console EULA from the PC build.[/list][h2][b]Audio[/b][/h2]
[list][*] Xbox players can now hear PlayStation players in voice chat during matches.
[*] Corrected voice line for the first drone encounter in S.O.G. Mission 4, which now plays the intended line.
[*] Matchmaking voice line for drone encounter now plays correctly in S.O.G Mission 4.[/list][h2][b]Art & Animation[/b][/h2]
[list][*] Fixed backface mesh visibility on the map in Horde_Boreas_North.
[*] Fixed texture inconsistencies on the floor for Agni Hive Hunt.
[*] Sniper Trooper model skeleton no longer deforms.
[*] The Engineer’s backpack now displays the updated operator logo.
[*] Trooper’s equipped helmet decals no longer appear on Carnage corpses.[/list][h2][b]Localization[/b][/h2]
[list][*] Addressed untranslated English text on the newest Steam build.
[*] Completed missing strings for "Respawn Ready and At."
[*] Corrected incorrect display of "Exterminate Tigers" with the proper string.
[*] Corrected partial display of the "Й" symbol in Russian text.
[*] Corrected overlapping of voice chat instructions with controller image in settings for Japanese, Russian, and French.
[*] Fixed progression text displaying in English for all languages.
[*] Fixed possible text issue in the item description for “Cluster Grenade”.
[*] Fixed untranslated texts on several menus and features.
[*] Fixed text errors in the English language.
[*] Fixed broken text string in the “Settings” Menu for the French language.
[*] Fixed text overlapping the button on the match results screen under the company tab for the Russian language.
[*] Fixed limited space causing incorrect line breaks in the construction tutorial for the Chinese language. 
[*] Localized the graphic text “Main Missions” on the Main HUD.
[*] Resolved English text displaying on the “Mission Info” Screen for the tutorial on consoles.
[*] Shock Grenade description is now consistent across instances and across all languages.[/list][h2][b]UI[/b][/h2]
[list][*] Adjusted the text name on “Settings” to fit its description text.
[*] Corrected "Nuclear Det Pack" description to reflect proper timing.
[*] Corrected item description in DLC referencing a trailer in the rights section.
[*] Fixed truncated display of secondary weapon level by Rico on the S.O.G “After Action Report” (AAR) screen.
[*] Fixed an incorrect player distance display from Data Pads in S.O.G. Mission 13.
[*] Fixed overlapping text fields in the tutorial on PS5.
[*] "Failed" status no longer displays in the Completed Activities history after finishing all SOG Missions.
[*] “Galactic Front” info banner and button now appear on the “Play” tab while active.
[*] Tooltip no longer appears on the cursor when hovering over the “Fed Net News” tab during Galactic Front’s pending state.
[*] "Team" and "Local" chat icons no longer overlap when spamming "Party Chat" in the Main Menu.
[*] "Mission ends in X min" timer added to the Company Ops mission panel.
[*] Mission details for party members now display correctly when queuing for Company Operations.
[*] The cooldown icon no longer overlaps with the ability icon.
[*] The correct mission timer and label are now displayed on the Company Operations mission panel.
[*] The “Company Ops” mission icon now correctly appears gold.
[*] The “Company Operations” mission panel displays the correct mission name.
[*] The "Restore Default" button for video settings now functions correctly.[/list][h2][b]Gameplay & General Fixes[/b][/h2]
[list][*] AI Troopers no longer get stuck on ledges near the Pit on Planet X-11.
[*] Fixed issue where companies created on different consoles were not displayed correctly in cross-platform play.
[*] Fixed a bug where the Narrative Slideshow did not appear after achieving a new stage on Galactic Front.
[*] Fixed a black screen issue when queuing, previously preventing players from spawning.
[*] Redeploying no longer causes Troopers to become invincible.
[*] Resolved clipping issues for players near rocks in Horde_Boreas_North and the snow-covered rock near the dropship in AAS_Boreas_6.
[*] Rocks on X-11 now have collision to prevent players from falling through.
[*] "Scan Dart" duration now matches the intended 15 seconds.
[*] The Barrage ability now affects hive eggs properly in Hive Hunt missions.
[*] Traitors no longer have access to the redeploy button, as it allows them to get stuck in a bad state.
[*] Warrior Soldiers no longer spawn inside walls during S.O.G Mission 9.[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.0.3 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Update 1.0.3 will be available for troopers to download [b]October 21st, 2024[/b] at [b]10 AM PT (GMT-7)[/b].

This patch is a collection of content, performance, and optimization improvements and numerous bug fixes. If you'd like to discuss Update 1.0.3 with your fellow troopers, please feel free to join the [url=https://discord.com/invite/starshiptroopersgame][b]Starship Troopers: Extermination Community Discord[/b][/url]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43269229/0f7bd3125d798978cf93379569e2c24756468243.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]Client Performance Improvements[/b][/h2]
[list][*] Optimization to Weapon Swapping
[*] Bug LOD'ing Optimizations
[*] Sound now plays without registering and unregistering Audio[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43269229/2b8cdbfd9c09a9cf77cbea1234ab5158a1d2b3cc.jpg[/img]
[h2][b]Quality-of-Life[/b][/h2]
[h3][b]Companies[/b][/h3]
We have now added the highly requested search feature to help troopers find companies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43269229/ea2cbd342fa7faba61b9cea207ad86a138d8c417.jpg[/img]
“[b]Suggested Companies[/b]” can now be filtered with search text in the “[b]Company[/b]” tab. This can be found on the top right of the ”Company” page.[list][*] Enter the exact name of the Company to join, or the first few letters from its name to find a list of Companies whose names start with those letters. 
[*] Delete the entire search text to get back to a list of unfiltered suggested companies.[/list]For example: “The Hunters” will probably find and list just that Company, but entering just “The” will list all Companies starting with that prefix.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43269229/aaa9b3a1820b2aadfd7b330c026ecd2894fa16db.png[/img]
We are continuing to work on additional Quality-of-Life features for the Company system, such as the much-requested “Invite Friend to Company” feature, and look to release them in future updates. We are grateful to the community and continue to welcome trooper feedback on the Company and Social systems of Starship Troopers: Extermination.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43269229/5966a31475b357db4334788c15c32b4857bce260.jpg[/img]

[list][*] Fixed an issue where the “Join Friend via Activity” showed the incorrect status and would fail to reconnect to matches on PS5.
[*] Fixed an issue where the game would crash when starting a S.O.G. mission on Xbox.
[*] Fixed an issue where Weapon Skin Customization would not work correctly.
[*] Fixed an issue where the title screen would freeze and display a “suspendPoint” error when users tried to queue for a mission.

[*] Fixed an issue where the story page could not be changed when players rapidly pressed the Y/Triangle button after switching to the “Galactic Front” menu tab.
[*] Fixed an issue that would cause an infinite matchmaking loop when only one player is in the party.
[*] Fixed an issue on Agni Prime AAS Easy, which caused stuttering and FPS drops at the start of the match.
[*] Fixed an issue where player gamertags that have been changed would not update on Company screens.
[*] Fixed an issue where troopers were unable to enter Planet Valaka after a first attempt causing “Connection Timeout” and a black screen.
[*] Fixed an issue causing the Build Tool to be in Place mode when equipping it for the “Equip the Build Tool” mission objective in the Tutorial mission.
[*] Fixed an issue where a second invitation would not arrive when sent from a full party.
[*] Fixed an issue causing “Output Device” to be cut off in the “Settings/Audio” menu.
[*] Fixed an issue where rapidly changing “Video” settings on Agni Prime would cause consoles to crash.
[*] Fixed an issue where users could find themselves stuck in matchmaking while queuing for a Hive Hunt mission.[/list][h2][b]UI[/b][/h2]
[list][*] Fixed an issue where players with Online IDs/Gamer tags longer than 16 characters exceeded the banner/nameplate holder.
[*] Removed unnecessary HUD elements from S.O.G. missions.
[*] Added HUD markers for downed squadmates during S.O.G.missions.
[*] Fixed an issue where the "Rico Speaking" text appeared on the S.O.G. reset campaign screen.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Living Planet would get stuck in a victory state even after a new war started.[/list][h2][b]Audio[/b][/h2]
[list][*] Fixed an issue where players joining a Horde mode late would have no background music.
[*] Fixed an issue where the main menu music would not play after exiting to the Credits.
[*] Fixed an issue where the main menu music changed when the player clicked on "Main Mission."
[*] Fixed an infinite loop caused by a single AI trooper trying to vocalize.
[/list][h2][b]Art & Animation[/b][/h2]
[list][*] Fixed a bug where rounds from the [b]E-Pulse 88 CSW[/b] consistently fired below the reticle during sustained fire.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Sniper character model used the Ranger texture for its backpack.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Frost Drone body LOD appeared invisible at a distance.
[*] Fixed backward shoulder patches on trooper models.
[*] Fixed stretched and blurry ground textures in S.O.G. missions.[/list][h2][b]Gameplay & General Fixes[/b][/h2]
[list][*] Fixed the handling of the Sniper with the [b]Morita Hawkeye[/b], which previously depended on the gun selected.
[*] Fixed incorrect damage resistance for the Tanker bug against [b]Hi-Ex Grenades[/b].
[*] Fixed inconsistent translations for the Demolisher, Guardian, and Ranger Trooper classes.
[*] Fixed an issue where the "Restart Needed - Graphical assets need a restart to be localized" screen was not localized after a language change.
[*] Fixed an inconsistency in the naming of Planet X-11, where it was referred to as "X11" in some strings.
[*] Fixed an issue where users were unable to progress on the ARC mission using the X-11 map.
[*] Fixed an issue where S.O.G. Bots did not follow the user immediately after leaving the Dropship in several S.O.G. missions.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Tiger could spawn inside a wall during the 5th Encounter in S.O.G. Mission #9.
[*] Fixed an incorrect mission objective on the Tac Map screen for S.O.G. Mission 12.
[*] Fixed non-player-facing text appearing in the mission briefing for S.O.G. Mission 18.
[*] Fixed inconsistent objective listings on the Tac Map and Scoreboard for S.O.G. Mission #20.
[*] Fixed an issue where the game did not refocus after closing a social menu modal window in the pause menu.
[*] Fixed an issue where the player no longer received a "Kicked" modal from the company after losing internet connection.
[*] Fixed an issue where players could move while holding a resource canister when using class abilities that should lock them in place.
[*] Fixed an incorrect distance-from-objective indicator when multiple objectives were active.
[*] Fixed an issue where the player could unlock during extraction instead of after winning on normal difficulties.
[*] Fixed an issue where S.O.G. Bots would float and become stuck if a Carnage corpse was destroyed while they stood on it.
[*] Fixed an issue causing a disappearing utility item when a player picked up a 4th utility item.[/list]

notes.title: Federation Dossier: Information on the Galactic Front
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43269229/138b00c596e8ce1b9318405edefd82ff89245552.jpg[/img]

Troopers! We’ve gotten a lot of questions from you over the past few days on our fight in the Galactic Front against the Arachnids. We want you to enter the battle prepared, so we’ve taken the time to write up this Federation Dossier to answer your trooper's most asked questions to provide you the clarity needed to take this fight to the Bugs! Read below, troopers, and get up to date on how the Galactic Front works from Lead Game Designer Chaz Barker!

[h2][b]What Is the Galactic Front Event?[/b][/h2]

The Galactic Front is a limited-time event where players band together in Companies (Clans) to fight against the Bug menace and complete Company Operations. Winning Company Operations earns Victory Points (VP) for the Federation. Victory Points accumulate toward community-driven goals — all players work together to hit global milestones over the event’s duration.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43269229/257d61578e63ccbaa5e491f9d648cf2e161a0652.png[/img]
[h2][b]How Long Will the Galactic Front Last?[/b][/h2]

The Galactic Front is an ongoing operation that lasts for several weeks. Each Front is a wholly new story and, as such, maybe longer or shorter depending on the way the narrative unfolds and what new mechanics or events occur.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43269229/e4ba5a18f77d9f85bf2eddf2730c588ac624ea71.png[/img]

Players will have this time to participate in missions, earn Intel, launch Company Operations, and contribute to the global Victory Point pool to unlock milestones.

The current front “[b]A New Frontier[/b]” will last until the end of [b]December[/b] to give new players a chance to participate during the holiday season but could end sooner if Victory Conditions are met! This also gives us time to analyze and re-balance. If the community completes the event before the last day the “[b]Spoils of War[/b]” prizes will be awarded to all player accounts over the proceeding couple of days.

[h2][b]Do I Need to Participate in the Galactic Front to Get Rewards?[/b][/h2]

The Galactic Front represents humanity's efforts against the Arachnid threat. As such, if humanity wins, we all win! So in the spirit of that, if the community gets enough Victory Points before the end of the event, then everyone with an account at the time of victory gets the “[b]Spoils of War[/b]” prizes.

The final milestone must be completed before the time runs out in order for the community to get the prizes. This is not assured. [b]Everyone must DO THEIR PART![/b]

[h2][b]How Do I Participate in the Galactic Front?[/b][/h2]

To participate, players can join or create a Company (Clans). Where they can complete regular missions to earn Intel for their Company. Company officers can then use Intel to initiate “Company Operations”, where your performance contributes to the global Victory Points earned. You can track the Federation’s progress in the “Galactic Front” tab of the main menu. You can also see the Federation's progress by looking at the uncovered areas of fog on the planet's surface.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43269229/534ae93f365037c8896442d5eb9c8f2d7f23f344.jpg[/img]
[h2][b]What Are Company Officers?[/b][/h2]

The initial creator of a Company is automatically an Officer. This assignment gives the authority to create Company Operations using the Company’s shared Intel. However, they can also promote other members of the Company to Officers to help with the management of Company Operations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43269229/58ab8b3504e10df5fdd02e457f25fcc78eb3387a.png[/img]

[h2][b]Am I Required to Join a Company to Participate in the Galactic Front?[/b][/h2]

In a way, yes but we want to stress that players can create a very small Company even if just by themself and they can create Company Operations for the Community to matchmake into and contribute to the Victory Point total.

[h2][b]What Are the Different Types of Missions?[/b][/h2]

[b]Regular Missions[/b]: These are the hourly missions that cycle and reward Intel, the currency used to initiate Company Operations. These missions are available even outside of Galactic Front events.

[b]Company Operations[/b]: These missions are only available during a Galactic Front story event and [b]require [/b]Intel to start and award Victory Points based on the performance of the Company members participating.

[h2][b]What are Company Operations?[/b][/h2]

Company Operations are special missions that the Company Officers can create using Intel. Think of it like a Mission Creation system. Instead of waiting for random missions to cycle, we want to give the Community more choices while still keeping our matchmaking time as short as possible.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43269229/4a88302ca966cfbbe2a02c0fcc56f8fe6bf2340f.png[/img]
Just like regular missions, Company Operations can have Mutations, but they also have specific Objectives e.g. “Kill 500 Drones” that give extra Victory Points if completed.

[h2][b]How Do I Create a Company Operation?[/b][/h2]

First ensure you join or create a Company using the Company screen accessed via the main menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43269229/4b19e2a82ffeb9e710f67e33fc2039653f8207c6.png[/img]
Once you are part of a Company, and an officer, navigate to the “[b]Play[/b]” screen as usual through the Main Missions flow.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43269229/ccdce54815b098d54eff3106ea760c15a754cc40.png[/img]
Click the “[b]Create Company Ops[/b]” button to see a selection of Company Operations to purchase for your Company.

Each Company Operation is a curated mission with different difficulty levels, mutations, maps and objectives to choose from.

Once an Officer has made a selection, they can spend the Company’s shared Intel to create that Company Operation for their Company and the entire Community to matchmake into.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43269229/b75505128c4ef5b92fb6ba9a3f19f6d3832a4685.png[/img]
If there is not enough Intel to purchase the Operation then members will need to complete regular missions to collect more.  This limitation prevents too many Company Operations being generated and the matchmaking system from becoming overwhelmed and slowing down due to the matchmaking population splitting up into smaller groups.

[h2][b]How Do I Earn Intel, and How Much Do I Need to Start a Company Operation?[/b][/h2]

Intel is a currency earned from regular missions, it accumulates in the Company’s wallet. The Company Officers can then spend that currency to create a Company Operation that troopers can deploy to for a pre-defined period of time (usually an hour).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43269229/4e4474b3e0558ff09da843e091f13f052fea8317.png[/img]

Again, we want to give the Player Community more choice of missions and make them thematic to the current story. The Intel limitation is a mechanic to keep our matchmaking time as short as possible.

On average, each Special Operation costs about 100 Intel to initiate, but the cost scales up with difficulty. We balance this up or down to ensure the community isn’t too split up, this allows matchmaking times to stay low while giving more mission choices to players.

Company members can earn Intel by completing regular missions, and the Intel they collect is pooled within their Company for officers to use.

Troopers do not need to be within the same company to get the Intel rewards when joining Company Operations. Troopers can also use the Quickplay to join other Company Operations our current matchmaking will prioritize troopers joining these missions!

[h2][b]What Are Victory Points (VP), and How Do I Earn Them?[/b][/h2]

Victory Points are the primary metric for the Galactic Front. They represent the Federation's progress in the campaign against the Bugs. Victory Points are earned by participating in Company Operations, where players are awarded medals based on their performance. Each medal contributes a certain number of VP to your Company, and the total VP helps the global community hit event milestones.

[h2][b]How Are Medals Distributed in Company Operations, and What Do They Mean?[/b][/h2]

Medals are awarded in Company Operations based on performance. Each operation awards 1 gold medal for mission victory and potentially additional bronze, silver and gold medals based on the Objectives.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43269229/7b30637a694a5f0f15387eccda1dc69b0fd2eb2b.png[/img]
Each medal contributes a variable amount of VP, but the value of gold medals is always higher than silver and so on, for example,
[list][*] Gold Medal: [b]100 VP[/b]
[*] Silver Medal: [b]50 VP[/b]
[*] Bronze Medal: [b]25 VP [/b][/list]The total number of VP earned depends on the number of medals and the number of Company members participating.

[h2][b]What Are Milestones, and Why Are They Important?[/b][/h2]

Milestones are community-wide goals that the global player base works towards during the Galactic Front. As the global Victory Points total increases, milestones are unlocked. As stated before troopers can also view this on the Planet's surface as the Federation clears the planet’s fog of war.

After a milestone is unlocked, a new set of Company Operation options will be made available.

These will have new maps, mutations and objectives that map to the current phase of the story or to special events that are advertised currently on our [url=https://twitter.com/TroopersExt][b]social media[/b][/url] and [b]Discord[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43269229/867eb442f60a54919ed5bc239b1a0eb5371ffcb3.png[/img]

If the final milestone is unlocked before the time expires the whole player base is given rewards like cosmetic items, new content, or other exclusive customizations.

In “The New Frontier” Galactic Front, the rewards are a [b]Boreas-themed Visor, Decal and Weapon Skin[/b].

[h2][b]How Can I Track Our Progress in the Galactic Front?[/b][/h2]

Players can track the whole community's progression through the Galactic Front tab on the main menu. It shows the Intel Companies have collected, the number of Special Operations the Community has completed, and how close the global community is to reaching the next milestone.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43269229/75d7db5a9b24dba62413fb6130b60e4477f141f5.png[/img]

[h2][b]What Happens When the Galactic Front Ends?[/b][/h2]

If the Federation finishes the final milestone before time runs out, the community has succeeded. The Sky Marshal will debrief and start preparations for the next Galactic Front. At the end of the event, all rewards are given to the entire community (all players with a game account). This distribution may take a few days as we deliver the Spoils of War to all troopers!).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43269229/fe455ab7119239165a7a5d0e843393c018d1578b.png[/img]
If the final milestone is not achieved before the time runs out the Federation has failed in its objectives. The Sky Marshal will probably have something motivational to say about the matter and the rewards will not be distributed to the Troopers. Perhaps one day, they will be available again in a future Galactic Front…

Once the Galactic Front is over, normal missions will continue, but the special Company Operations will [b]no longer[/b] be available.

───

We hope this Federation Dossier has answered some of the key questions troopers have been asking about the Galactic Front and our mission to defeat the Arachnid Menace. At Federation R&D, we want every troop to know that the Federation remains committed to supporting your efforts against the Bugs. Your feedback and field reports are vital to the success of our operations, and together, we will ensure victory! 

Additionally, we have a message from Federation Command,

“We are incredibly grateful for the support from troopers on the field and we love hearing the feedback about Starship Troopers: Extermination from both newly enlisted recruits and long-time veterans troopers alike. We want to keep you all updated and let troopers know we are hard at work aiming to deliver the highly requested Company Search feature as soon as we can and continue to work on improving the Quality of Life with our social systems.

We aim to keep all troopers updated on our development, and we want troopers to feel reassured that the Deepspace Vanguard and Starship Troopers: Extermination will remain and that troopers can pick up and join the Federation cause whenever they are ready as we will continue to bring updates, dev blogs, and more to you all so you all can bring the fight to the Bugs!

Thanks, Project Lead Peter Maurice AKA [O] PMO"

If you want to chat with your fellow Troopers and get a first-hand look at what others have experienced in the Galactic Front, you can find more troopers in our [url=https://discord.com/invite/starshiptroopersgame][b]Starship Troopers: Extermination Community Discord[/b][/url].

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1268750/Starship_Troopers_Extermination/

notes.title: Update 1.0 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Update 1.0 will be available for troopers to download on [b]PC[/b], [b]PS5[/b], and [b]Xbox X|S[/b] on [b]October 10th, 2024[/b], at [b]5:00 PM PDT[/b].

This patch is a collection of content, performance, and optimization improvements and numerous bug fixes. Update 1.0 marks our exit out of early access as well as our entry onto console. If you'd like to discuss Update 1.0 with your fellow troopers, please feel free to join the [url=https://discord.gg/starshiptroopersgame][b]Starship Troopers: Extermination Community Discord![/b][/url]

[b]Please Note[/b]: Starting tomorrow October 10th at 9 AM PT. Federation R&D will begin prepping our transition into Update 1.0. Troopers may experience some periods of instability this is a known side effect of the transition, and we appreciate any patience from troopers playing and look forward to you all experiencing and seeing what you troopers do when the Update is fully released. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43269229/0f7bd3125d798978cf93379569e2c24756468243.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]Client Performance Improvements[/b][/h2]
[list][*] General UI optimization.
[*] Adjustments to haze effects.
[*] Removed railings artifacts from Nanite.
[*] Optimizations to game save/load.
[*] Optimizations to memory usage for UI Elements.
[*] Optimizations to memory usage for Bugs.
[*] Tweaks and optimizations to bug movement update and relevancy.
[*] Small optimizations for Carnage.
[*] Optimization pass for Audio Events.
[*] Optimization rendered trooper in UI.
[*] Fix an issue causing some particle effects to become immortal.
[*] Fix for rare but persistent ragdoll crash.
[*] Fix for Audio Component memory leak.[/list][h2][b]Map Performance Improvements[/b][/h2]
[list][*] Texture optimization for PC.
[*] Agni landscape performance tweak to lower memory usage and total draw calls.
[*] VSM CVar tweaks for better shadow performance.
[*] Remove some texture hard references to lower mission memory usage.
[*] Reparenting of existing material instances so they don't load the original textures, thus reducing texture memory footprint.
[*] Optimized heightmap resolutions for landscape on Valaka and Agni Prime.
[*] Reducing vert count on landscape and merging foliage actors/proxies Agni Prime.
[*] Remove WPO on all materials used by nanite meshes to minimize cache invalidations.
[*] Lighting optimization on all maps.
[*] Reducing texture sizes where appropriate in all maps.
[*] Adjusted collisions on several meshes across maps to use simple collisions instead of complex as simple.
[*] Nanite conversion pass on all maps to catch any lingering non-nanite meshes.[/list][h2][b]Server Performance Improvements[/b][/h2]
[list][*] Optimizations to bug collision configs.
[*] Further optimizations to bug spawning logic.
[*] Various optimizations of memory usage.
[*] Optimize memory usage for navigation.
[*] Reduced the cost of the significance manager on the Trooper movements.[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43269229/2b8cdbfd9c09a9cf77cbea1234ab5158a1d2b3cc.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]Special Operations Group (S.O.G)[/b][/h2]
The Special Operations Group is our Solo Play Tutorial mode that will help troopers get more acquainted with Starship Troopers: Extermination while providing more narrative depth for our more experienced troopers. Troopers will be able to serve alongside General J Rico for 25 missions within Chapter 1, with more Chapters in-development.

[h2][b]Crossplay (PC / PS5 / Xbox X|S)[/b][/h2]
In Update 1.0 Troopers for our respective platforms of [b]PC[/b], [b]PS5 [/b]and[b] Xbox Series X | S[/b] will be able to play Starship Troopers: Extermination with each other. Please note: Starship Troopers: Extermination will NOT feature Cross-save/Cross-platform progression. Data from your PC profile will be NON-TRANSFERRABLE from PC to Console and vice versa, you will be considered a newly enlisted trooper if you make the change in platform.

[h2][b]Companies[/b][/h2]
Want to be like Rico and have your own version of the Roughnecks? In Starship Troopers: Extermination, a "Company" is a group of players who are encouraged to play together and work within the community to achieve great accomplishments, particularly in Galactic Fronts![h3][b]Being in a Trooper Company allows:[/b][/h3]
[list][*] As a Company member, you can join your Company’s Operations, which are missions created by your Company’s Officers.
[*] As a Company member, you earn Victory Points and contribute towards the overall Galactic Front Campaign.
[*] As a Company member, Mission Victories earn Intel for your Company, which is used by Officers to create Operations.
[*] As a Company member, you can easily find similar players for matchmaking into fuller missions with people you’ve played with before.[/list][h3][b]As a Company Officer, you can:[/b][/h3]
[list][*] Launch Company Operations. Select from a curated list of exclusive Missions, giving your Company Members more choices for matchmaking and contribution to the Galactic Front![/list]In the future, we’ll be adding more quality-of-life features to Companies to help players build a thriving community.

[h2][b]Galactic Front[/b][/h2]
The War affects every Trooper, everywhere in our great Federation! While the Galactic Front is active, we all work as one community towards a common goal. Everybody fights, no one quits.

The Galactic War takes place over multiple Galactic Fronts; these are focused Campaigns organized and directed by the Sky Marshal. The Campaigns are massive in scale and impact, crossing the galaxy with their scope and lofty aspirational end-games. The Front is the connective layer between every Mission played.

To participate, players must join a Company Operation. Company Operations are special mission opportunities launched by Company Officers across the Federation.

[h3][b]Victory Points[/b][/h3]
[list][*] Every Company Operation provides opportunities to earn Victory Points. These opportunities are known as Objectives. Each completed Objective earns Victory Points, improving the overall Galactic Front progress.
[*] Work with your Company members to maximize the number of Victory Points earned for each Operation created![/list][h3][b]Galactic Front Milestones[/b][/h3]
[list][*] The War Progress is a community goal, where all participating players and Companies contribute Victory Points.
[*] Depending on the total Victory Points earned by the entire community, different outcomes will affect the Campaign “Spoils of War” rewards and the ongoing storyline in the Starship Troopers: Extermination Universe.
[*] Finish the Galactic Front within the time given by the Sky Marshal, and the Spoils of War will be yours![/list]
[h2][b]Tanker Bug[/b][/h2]
Brace yourselves, Troopers! In our latest update, we’re introducing a deadly new foe to the battlefield: the Tanker Bug. This massive, hulking insect is a force of nature, capable of turning the tide of battle with sheer brute strength and its terrifying abilities. 

With its searing, high-pressure stream of flammable liquid that it spews from its maw, capable of incinerating anything (or anyone) in its path. If you’re caught in its blast zone, you’d better move fast or face instant obliteration. 

You'll need teamwork, heavy firepower, strategic positioning, and the will to survive when this behemoth charges onto the field. Stay on your toes and bring that Bug down!

notes.title: Announcing Update 1.0
notes.content:
Offworld is happy to announce that Update 1.0 for Starship Troopers: Extermination will be released on [b]October 10th[/b] at [b]5PM PDT[/b]. Update 1.0 will introduce the world of Starship Troopers: Extermination to not only [b]PC [/b]but to console on [b]PS5 [/b]and [b]Xbox Series X | S[/b].

This is just the beginning for Starship Troopers: Extermination. So bring the fight to the Bugs and make sure everyone makes it out alive! We will be releasing the full patch notes soon, but you can find below a quick summary of what our new and veteran troopers can expect in Update 1.0.

[h2][b]Crossplay[/b][/h2]
Starship Troopers: Extermination will be featuring Crossplay come October 11th, 2024! PC troopers will now be able to play with the new batch of recruits on consoles! Please note: Starship Troopers: Extermination will [b]NOT [/b]feature [b]Cross-save/Cross-platform progression[/b]. Data from your PC profile will be [b]NON-TRANSFERABLE[/b] from PC to Console and vice versa; you will be considered a newly enlisted trooper if you make the change in platform.

[h2][b]Companies [/b][/h2]
Troopers can now join or create a "Company" with their fellow troopers. Companies play an integral role in the Galactic War and we encourage all troopers to play together and work within Companies to achieve great accomplishments in the name of the Federation!

[h2][b]Boreas[/b][/h2]
The Federation is prepping the Mobile Infantry to investigate the Planet Boreas, a frosty wasteland of a rock and infested with pesky Bugs. Do what needs to be done and bring the heat to Archie!

[h2][b]Galactic Front [/b][/h2]
The Galactic War is in full swing and takes place over multiple Galactic Fronts; these are focused Campaigns organized and directed by Sky Marshal Catherine “Ramrod” Ramsay. The Campaigns are massive in scale and impact, and the Sky Marshal guarantees troopers will be rewarded for their valiant efforts if the community can successfully complete all phases of the Galactic Front. 

To participate, players must join a Company Operation. Company Operations are special mission opportunities launched by Company Officers across the Federation.

───

Thank you, troopers, for enlisting in the Mobile Infantry and continuing the fight against the Bug Menace for the Federation after all this time. The Patch Notes will contain a lot more information on what players can expect with the update and we will share them when it is time. We hope all troopers look forward to the update and can exterminate those pesky Arachnids for the betterment of the Federation! 

As we exit Early Access and continue our development, we still welcome and greatly appreciate all the feedback from our loyal troopers. We also encourage all troopers who are already enlisted to give us a review on Steam, or If you’re excited and want to get a head start on finding troopers for your own company, come and join the [url=https://discord.com/invite/starshiptroopersgame][b]Starship Troopers: Extermination Community Discord[/b][/url]. 

A reminder that Starship Troopers: Extermination is leaving Early Access [b]October 11th, 2024[/b] and that now is the best time for you to enlist in the Mobile Infantry as the price will be increasing from [b]$29.99 USD[/b] to [b]$49.99 USD[/b] for the troopers that want to know more the Collector’s Edition of Starship Troopers: Extermination is also now available for [b]PS5[/b], [b]Xbox X | S[/b], and [b]PC[/b]! Troopers will be able to pre-order from [b]September 24th, 2024[/b] to [b]October 27, 2024[/b] supplies are limited trooper so make sure you reserve yours today on the Limited Run Games website [url=https://bit.ly/3Blw78A][b]HERE[/b][/url]!

[h2][b]See you on Boreas and Kill ’em All, Troopers![/b][/h2]

notes.title: Federation Dossier: Special Operations Group (S.O.G.)
notes.content:
Being called on by the Hero of Planet P, is a tall order, and we know troopers are excited to jump in and prove their skills to General Rico. The Federation wants to shed some more light on the program to prepare troopers on what to expect if they choose to partake in the Special Operations Group. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43269229/caf500445b20701de2ba53754178d9caee409035.jpg[/img]

Our Special Operations Group serves as the solo play tutorial in Starship Troopers: Extermination. This solo play tutorial will make up a multi-chapter journey, with its first chapter “[b]Answering the Call[/b]” releasing on [b]October 11[/b]. While even the most experienced troopers can join the program, it is mainly designed for beginners, introducing our game mechanics, bugs, missions, and the expansive Starship Troopers Universe in an approachable and engaging way. 

In this solo play tutorial, players will answer the call from General Rico himself to join the ranks of the S.O.G. Throughout the [b]25[/b] missions included in the first chapter, new recruits will follow the general’s instructions across various mission levels, all set underground, including tunnels, and caves, facing against an Arachnid hive for the first time.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43269229/89c5d532ec6568e84620343829db46d6cd55e225.jpg[/img]
[h2][b]Learning the Ropes [/b][/h2]

Since the Early Access launch, we received a lot of feedback from players, which has been instrumental in shaping up the game to make it more fun and accessible. The solo play tutorial is a great example of this evolution. We received several common questions from new players, such as “How do I build a base?”, “How did this Bug kill me?”, and “What is this Ore thing?”, all of which are answered within our solo play tutorial.

[h2][b]Meet The NPC Comrades[/b][/h2]

The fight against the Bug can only be won together with your team; this is something you will learn early on in your journey. General Rico wants you to work as a team to accomplish the missions. That’s why in his S.O.G., you are not alone; [b]Moose[/b], [b]Scorch[/b], and [b]Jensen [/b]are your trusted NPCs in the solo play tutorial. 

New troopers will be able to learn the basics of customizing not just your own loadout but your NPC’s loadout as well with the best setup for the mission. This mode will also allow troopers to familiarize themselves with their weaponry, utility and perks in a more controlled environment. Remember our mission: everyone fights, no one quits!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43269229/a2736afba4bc897b8c33a9c4e8a1ce7ae5722ddd.jpg[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43269229/1320f794fa86e1493e3e11f7fd3b9f4e9eb83c13.jpg[/img]
[h2][b]A Trooper Handpicked for the S.O.G.[/b][/h2]

We want our troopers to make use of their time as part of the S.O.G. and to make the transition to our multiplayer and Galactic Front more smoothly. When our newly enlisted Troopers try multiplayer mode, they can join arms alongside fellow troopers with a solid understanding of the different Bug types, the fundamentals of base building, and the various mission objectives they will encounter. 

Chapter 1 of the solo mode, “[b]Answering the Call,[/b]” is just the start of your successful and, hopefully, long career in the S.O.G.; more chapters and content are planned for future updates. We will share more when we’re ready.

Are you an experienced trooper who has mastered the basics? As a veteran, you might find S.O.G operations a bit of a breeze, but General Rico will tell you “You don’t want to be in a fight, but if you are, you fight to win.” S.O.G. delves deeper into the narrative and lore of Starship Troopers: Extermination, enriching the experience for veterans and newbies alike. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43269229/eb174f2342d7a2ebbf394b1f4eaaa1121f1d2e6f.jpg[/img]
If you haven’t yet, you can learn more about your fellow troopers who will be accompanying you in Rico’s Special Operation Group by checking out the Declassified S.O.G. dossiers here:
[list][*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1268750/announcements/detail/4588693113447627927][b]S.O.G. Dossier - Demolisher Jackson “Moose” Callahan[/b][/url]
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1268750/view/4597700946277670038][b]S.O.G. Dossier - Ranger Taral “Scorch” Ashcroft[/b][/url]
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1268750/view/4665255575215843737?l=english][b]S.O.G. Dossier - Medic Olivia “Jensen” Jensen[/b][/url][/list]───

We hope this developer blog answered some of the questions about what both new and veteran players can expect with our solo play tutorial S.O.G game mode. We wish you the best of luck under the command of General Rico, and we’re sure you’ll do the Federation proud.

As a reminder, Starship Troopers: Extermination is still in Early Access and is available for [b]$29.99 USD[/b] until [b]October 11, 2024[/b] when we will leave Early Access and the price increases to [b]$49.99 USD[/b]. The standard version of Starship Troopers: Extermination is available for pre-order, and you can find your local retailer [url=https://play.starshiptroopersextermination.com/ca/en/][b]HERE[/b][/url]. Remember, you can support the Federation and our mission against the Bug menace and wishlist Starship Troopers: Extermination; Or if you’re already enlisted, the Federation welcomes you to give us a review on Steam today! 

In addition, The Collector’s Edition of Starship Troopers: Extermination is now available for [b]PS5[/b], [b]Xbox X|S[/b], and [b]PC[/b]! Troopers will be able to pre-order from [b]September 24th, 2024[/b] to [b]October 27, 2024[/b] on the Limited Run Games website [url=https://bit.ly/3Blw78A][b]HERE[/b][/url]!

Lastly, If you want to chat with your fellow Troopers and S.O.G. hopefuls, you can find more troopers in our [url=https://discord.com/invite/starshiptroopersgame][b]Starship Troopers: Extermination Community Discord[/b][/url].

[h2][b]Stay tuned, and get ready to take the fight to the Bugs![/b][/h2]

notes.title: Starship Troopers: Extermination announces the Tanker Bug, Boreas, and More!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43269229/d099438b1c16b0de3e7313574192f464a047dd93.jpg[/img]

Listen up, Troopers message incoming from the United Citizen Federation!

Offworld has landed in Cologne, Germany for Gamescom ahead of the Starship Troopers: Extermination launch on console for [b]PC, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X | S this coming October 11th, 2024[/b]. As part of this event, troopers were able to get a special inside look showcasing the next Arachnid foe of the Tanker Bug, our new frosty locale Boreas, and also a first look at General Rico’s Special Operations Group (S.O.G.).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43269229/1f88e7870514bc940d9c7db875f446186cc5660d.jpg[/img]
The Tanker Bug is a new enemy variant that is as deadly as it is massive, appearing just as it did in the 1997 film and necessitating careful strategy and teamwork to take it down. This ferocious and imposing Bug can burst through the ground without warning during matches, challenging players with its unpredictable nature and devastating incendiary stream. Don’t expect to bring down the Tanker Bug with bullets from afar; players should look to inspiration from the daring tactics of General Rico himself to exploit its weak points to defeat it.

Boreas, meanwhile, is a new ice planet, recently infested by the arrival of a Bug meteor. Set to debut alongside the console launch, this chilling environment presents a new battleground where players will face Bug variants adapted to the frigid environment in the Frost Drone and Frost Warrior. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43269229/7fac53a82952325c73a85393486cbc33f49309aa.png[/img]
Casper Van Dien reprises his role as General Johnny Rico. Code-named Special Operations Group (S.O.G.), this new solo play mode sees the player undertake a multitude of missions dispatched by the General himself as he brings together the best of the best from Spec Ops divisions within the UCF for top-secret assignments. Varying in scope and objectives, these missions are designed to prepare soldiers for the more challenging 16-person multiplayer missions; additional missions will be added in subsequent content updates beyond the October 11th launch.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43269229/1c029b662254665954c182fce4045632b1e3cc0e.png[/img]
If you missed out on the Gamescom you can catch up on our 1.0 release trailer and our Dev Diaries below!

[previewyoutube=Q-z4hGP89YM;full][/previewyoutube][h3][b]Gamescom Dev Diary[/b][/h3]

Grab some friends and enlist today to ensure the safety of our people and earn your citizenship!

───

If you need to find fellow troopers to help take down the pesky Tanker Bug come 1.0, we invite you to join the [url=https://discord.gg/starshiptroopersgame][b]ST:E Community Discord![/b][/url] There you can find the most up-to-date information on the development of ST:E!

notes.title: Update 0.8.0 Hotfix #2 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Update 0.8.0 Hotfix #2 is available for troopers to download [b]June 28th[/b] at [b]1:30PM PT (GMT-7)[/b]

This update is a hotfix to address community-reported issues following Update 0.8.0. If you'd like to discuss Update 0.8.0 Hotfix #2 with your fellow troopers, please feel free to join the [url=https://discord.gg/starshiptroopersgame][b]Starship Troopers: Extermination Community Discord[/b][/url]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43269229/e7079cd5b9ba40313104fe6be7cb6e3edb60256c.jpg[/img]
[h2][b]Horde Spawning Temporary Fix[/b][/h2]

Troopers may have experienced issues completing Horde mode, which prevented Horde waves from being completed. We have investigated the issue further and have discovered a cause.

During a Horde wave, we found that some Bugs would disappear or not spawn but still be listed as needing to be killed in the Mission Objective. The disappearance of the bugs is what prevented troopers from completing Horde waves.

We are still digging into where these Bugs end up, we suspect Brain Bugs to be involved. In the meantime, we are deploying a temporary fix that involves some other changes around it

[h2][b]Horde Spawning Changes[/b][/h2][list]
[*] Horde waves will now queue up [b]DOUBLE[/b] the amount of Bugs to spawn.
[*] The waves will still only require you to kill the original amount.
 [*] Ex: If a wave wants you to kill [b]50[/b] bugs, it will spawn a total of [b]100[/b] over the course of the wave.
[*] At the end of each wave, any remaining bugs on the field will burrow.
[*] At the end of Wave 10, the bug will not burrow but continue to assault you.
[*] The dropship extraction is now [b]INCREASED[/b] to the normal [b]3[/b] minutes since you have to deal with bugs now. 
[*] The Speed Modifier has been [b]REMOVED[/b] from Horde Mode. We will reintroduce it when we have a solid fix in place.[/list]This is a temporary fix we have in place to enable Horde mode for troopers, but it does have a few neat design additions to how Horde games will play out.[list][*] There is no longer a need to seek out and track bugs down; there are plenty to exterminate, keeping the pacing high until the end of the wave.[*] The end of Horde change is just something we are trying, and we will see how people feel. Whether you extract or not, you still get the XP reward from finishing the wave and completing Horde, and it brings back the excitement of extraction.[/list]We are committed to finding a lasting solution for Horde spawns. In the meantime, we hope this hotfix will bring troopers back into the excitement and action of the Horde gamemode! 

[h2][b]Modifier Changes[/b][/h2]

We will be [b]ENABLING[/b] the Warrior Ambush to all matches [b]EXCLUDING[/b] Horde and Hive Hunts. This is to help with the low Bug counts troopers experience during base defense.

[h2][b]Known Issues[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Troopers may face a lower rate of Bug spawns than expected. We are currently investigating our spawner logic for Bugs.
[*] When Bugs burrow, shooting them or interacting with them in any way that causes an animation will cause the burrow to break. With our temporary solution, this animation break will be more obvious to the average trooper.
[*] Bugs may also look like they are popping up briefly from burrows. With our temporary solution forcing bug burrows of so many bugs, this will be more obvious to the average trooper.
[*] Troopers may find themselves stuck in spectator view after being revived from the incapacitated state. The current workaround is to ask fellow troopers to incapacitate and revive you again. We will be adjusting our friendly fire systems until this is fixed to prevent troopers from being erroneously marked as Federation Traitors til this issue is resolved.
[*] Team Voice Chat sometimes stops working during a match. We are working with our Voice Chat provider for a solution.
[*] Previously usable controller bindings and settings may run into issues being changed. As an alternative fix, you may try using Steam Input.
[*] Troopers may see flickering texture issues If “Persistent Blood” in the settings is [b]ENABLED[/b]. 
[*] Troopers may find Bugs phasing through built gates and Carnage body piles.
[*] Bugs may experience increased knockback and float-off when affected by stagger.
[*] Extended Magazines may double your rounds. This is not intended, and respawning will cause this to go back to normal.
[*] Grenade cooldowns reset if you are incapacitated if it is still in cooldown.
[*] NVIDIA Shadowplay currently may not function.
[*] Missing labels and descriptions for the “Axis Bindings” settings menu.[/list]

notes.content:
[b]Update 0.8.0[/b] will be available for troopers to download on [b]June 24th, 2024[/b] at [b]10:00 AM PT[/b] ([b]GMT-7[/b]).

This patch is a collection of content, performance, and optimization improvements and numerous bug fixes. If you'd like to discuss Update 0.8.0 with your fellow troopers, please feel free to join the [url=https://discord.gg/starshiptroopersgame][b]Starship Troopers: Extermination Community Discord[/b][/url]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43269229/644fcbd088b3a7933c47f86c9a6d60fa3a99a37f.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Client Performance Improvements[/b][/h3][list][*] Gradually Improved Performance of UI across the game
[*] Gradually Improved Memory overhead across the game.
[*] Gradually Improved Performance of Physics based actions.
[*] Improved Performance regarding input fetching.
[*] Improved Performance for Trooper Animations.
[*] Improved Performance for Arachnids.
[*] Add a system to dynamically adjust tick rates based on their significance to the player.
[*] Reduced ticking across the game.
[*] Improved Performance for Skeletal Mesh Components.
[*] Fix an issue where the HUD was getting created each time you respawned.
[*] Fix an issue where Name Tags were more costly than they should be.
[*] Fix an issue where 3D Widgets were more costly than they should be.
[*] Improved performance of Bug movement component that reduced CPU load on client and server.[/list][h3][b]Map Performance Improvements[/b][/h3][list][*] Improve GPU Performance on Planet Valaka

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1268750/announcements/detail/6232499459752805489][h3][b]Planet X-11[/b][/h3][/url]
Planet X-11 is located within the Tibannis system but lies deep within the Arachnid Quarantine Zone and is designated a mining planet for the federation. It also serves a more important role as it is the home of the Teefang Array Deep Space Listening post. The planet has been discovered by the bugs and is now under constant attack and must be defended. Planet X-11 will launch with:[list][*] 2 [b]ARC[/b] Locations
[*] 2 [b]Horde[/b] Locations
[*] 8 [b]AAS[/b] Main Missions
[*] 4 [b]Hive Hunt[/b] Main Missions[/list][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1268750/announcements/detail/4156339304092992622][h3][b]Weak Points[/b][/h3][/url]
Introduce a new set of systems to expand the depth of our shooting mechanics. The goal is to try and make shooting the Arachnids more interesting, and it requires player knowledge to make sure that you are either using the right gun for the job or have a good enough aim to avoid hitting the armor. Add depth to our gameplay by providing each enemy with an armor class and each gun with an armor-piercing value. Allow players to use either knowledge (What guns have what AP value) or skill (Just aim for the weak points) when killing bugs

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1268750/announcements/detail/6232499459753020374][h3][b]The Carnage System[/b][/h3][/url]
Carnage is the new in-house system we’ve created that will let troopers have a true Starship Troopers experience with Persistent Bug Bodies. As you fight the Arachnids, their Bug corpses stay in the game until they are destroyed. Corpses will stack and be traversable by both friend and foe alike, and if sightlines are an issue, Troopers will be able to use their hands to melee or explosives to clear a path if needed.

[h3][b]Demolition Damage Type[/b][/h3]
Demolition damage-type classified weapons and utility will excel at removing bug corpses. 
[list][*] Switched Thermo Charge to Demolitions damage type.
[*] Switched Nuke Det Pack to Demolitions damage type.
[*] Switched Hi-Ex Grenade to Demolitions damage type.[/list][h3][b]Ammo Types[/b][/h3]
The Federation is introducing two new ammo types which we hope aids your mission in wiping out the Bug menace! These ammo types come with their own benefits and tradeoffs and we'll look to add more as we develop ST:E!
[list][*] Added FMJ Ammo which sets AP Rating to [b]4[/b], but decreases weak point damage to [b]1.25x[/b].
[*] Added Hollow Point ammo which increases weak point damage to [b]2x[/b], but decreases AP Rating to [b]2[/b].[/list][h2][b]Quality-of-Life[/b][/h2][h3][b]New First-Time User Experience[/b][/h3]
Troopers will now be able to choose [b]Language[/b], [b]Server Location[/b], and whether to run the [b]Tutorial[/b] right from the beginning of their first initial playthrough.    [h3][b]New Language Support[/b][/h3]
We have added Language support to the following languages:
[list][*] Italian
[*] Spanish
[*] Portuguese
[*] French[/list][h3][b]Controller Adjustments[/b][/h3]
Moving ping temporarily to [b]Aim Down Sight + Up[/b] on the [b]D-Pad[/b] for players on controller
[list][*] The end goal is to move Ping to its own binding ([b]Up on D-Pad[/b]), move [b]Cycle Utilites[/b] to the [b]Right on the D-Pad[/b], and all [b]Voice Chat Functions[/b] will be moved to the [b]Left on the D-Pad[/b].
[*] We are moving to this system to give both [b]Abilities[/b] and [b]Ping[/b] their own buttons on the controller instead of sharing the same one.
[*] If you play with a controller, please reset to defaults in the controls menu in settings to fix any issues you see around this.[/list][h3][b]Weapon Stat Display[/b][/h3]Weapon Stats have been adjusted to display as numbers instead of bars, giving more accurate readouts for players.

notes.title: Announcing Update 0.8.0: Carnage on Planet X-11
notes.content:
Troopers, we’re happy to announce that Update 0.8.0: Carnage on Planet X-11 will be set to launch for troopers to experience [b]June 24th, 2024[/b] at [b]10:00 AM PT[/b] ([b]GMT-7[/b]).

Remember to keep yourself in one piece out there. We will be releasing the full patch notes soon, but you can find below a summary of what Troopers can expect in Update 0.8.0.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43269229/cd3b7e63718d514411f5b47f6879c4dfe927f740.jpg[/img]

[h2][b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1268750/announcements/detail/4156339304092992622]Weak Points[/url][/b][/h2]
We introduce the much-anticipated Weak Points and Armor system, impacting all Bugs and Federation weaponry. Choose the right tool for the task and strike where it counts—right in the nerve stem! We're thrilled to finally bring this feature to the game, enabling you to serve the Federation with greater efficiency! So brush up on your aim, Troopers, and make use of what we taught you! For more details, click on the Weak Point System title above!

[h2][b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1268750/announcements/detail/6232499459752805489]Planet X-11[/url][/b][/h2]
Welcome to a new locale for the Deep Space Vanguard to explore, set in the Tibannis system within an Arachnid Quarantine Zone. This is our first major venture into blending interior and exterior settings. The area is shrouded in mystery, but for those eager to investigate, you might piece together what transpired here while fending off those pesky Bugs who have discovered the Listening Post! For more details on Planet X-11, click on the title above!

[h2][b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1268750/view/6232499459753020373]Carnage[/url][/b][/h2]
We're thrilled to introduce the Persistent Body System, which we've dubbed "Carnage," in Starship Troopers: Extermination. Bug bodies will no longer vanish after being slain, so it's up to you to hack them apart with your hands or blow them to smithereens with explosives. Kill them all, but beware: while a pile of dead bugs is a Trooper's greatest honor, the Bugs will also utilize their fallen comrades just as you use them for sightlines. For more details on Carnage, click on the title above!

[h2][b]Ammo Types[/b][/h2]
In Update 0.8.0, Federation R&D is introducing two new ammo types: [b]FMJ[/b] and [b]Hollow Points[/b]. These additions aim to enhance your effectiveness in exterminating Arachnids. Load them up and let R&D know how they perform. We'll continue researching and expanding your armory!

───

Besides that, Update 0.8.0 will include numerous quality-of-life changes, optimizations, and improvements we've been working on behind the scenes. We will share the patch notes soon, so hang tight, Troopers!

0.8.0 is a big leap into bringing the Starship Troopers experience into Extermination, and we hope all troopers will enjoy the content we're introducing. We can't wait for you to experience this update and look forward to your feedback as we continue to develop during this Early Access period.

If you haven’t yet, please feel free to join the [url=https://discord.gg/starshiptroopersgame][b]Starship Troopers: Extermination Community Discord[/b][/url]! Here, you can chat all things ST:E in general. 

With Update 0.8.0, Federation Command leaves you a simple message:

[h2][b]Embrace the Carnage Troopers.[/b][/h2]
